name: Situational Adaptation
description: It is basically a highly limited "have every super power" power. Your power would be adapting, meaning your power randomly changes to a given situation. For example, if you need to save a person falling from a building, you'd have the power of flight. Need to get a bomb out of a crowded area? Teleportation.  As soon as the problem is solved, it goes away.
summary: The ability to have a superpower useful in a given situation
strengths: Eliminates predictability when fighting foes.
Since you cannot choose your power, getting an unusual power for a given situation forces you to think outside the box.
Who knows. You might get omnipotence.
weaknesses: You cannot choose the power you are given, so it may be challenging.
You are powerless outside of situation when you need to save someone or stop a bad guy(No donut summoning)

name: Jumper
description: This is a very rare form of teleportation. A person can create psionic 'jump-scars' by using their mind to bend space-time. They appear as clear 'cracks' in midair, that can lead to any location on Earth that a person chooses. Some jump-scars have a short or long delay period, depending on their size.
summary: The ability to teleport to any location on Earth.
strengths: This is a very versatile power to have!
Escape from enemies in mere seconds, or become a very tricky opponent!!
weaknesses: Takes time to learn to control

name: Memory Tap
description: Just by touching the target you can tap into every single moment of their life that they can remember.  You can travel back in time to a chosen moment.  You have a period of 6 hours to change whatever you want about that memory before you are transported back to the present day.  While you are in the memory, the reality that contains the memory's owner is frozen.  If the owner of the memory dies while you are in the memory, you will be transported back to the present day.
summary: The ability to travel back in time to the memory of another person.
strengths: You can do this to anyone.
This power is easy to master.
weaknesses: You could get stuck in a paradox if you mess with the space time continuum.
You can still die in the memory.

name: Physics Rejector
description: When you have this ability, physics doesn't apply to you. It's automatic. So, no need to activate it. Do anything that physics says you can't like: Flying, running through walls, teleporting, the possibilities are endless.
summary: The ability to do anything you want because physics doesn't apply to you
strengths: Break physics
Run through gravity
Do all that's not forced down (this is a proverb)
weaknesses: There's no con, so have fun.

name: Superhuman Energy
description: Ever felt tired or lazy? With this superpower, you can have a lot of energy. Energy to do your homework, run across a bridge, dance. You can activate and deactivate this power at will. Don't overactivate this power, or you'll be hyper, paranoid, hypervigilant and will not sit still. You can stay up a few hours past bedtime. If you're extremely sleep deprived and forget to turn off this superpower, instead of staying awake, you'll fall asleep and awaken hours later temporarily confused and hyper.
summary: The ability to have increased levels of mental and psysical energy when you activate this power.
strengths: Have energy to do anything.
Activate and deactivate this power at will
Stay up for up to 4 hours past your bedtime.
weaknesses: You WILL fall asleep if you're extremely sleep deprived.
Overactivating this superpower could lead to hypervigilance, hyperness, and paranoia for a while
If you sleep while this superpower is activated, you'll wake up temporarily confused and hyper.

name: Omnipotent Power Mimicry
description: You can have every power in the world. You are also able to sense when a new power has been discovered, and you will know what it is. But you can only use one power a day, e.g. when someone needs to be saved from a moving train, you can choose to use super speed, but you are then stuck with that power until the end of the day (12:00 am).
summary: The ability to have every power in the world
strengths: You have every power in the world
You can sense when a new power has been discovered
You can choose what power you want to use
weaknesses: You can only have one power a day
You have to choose wisely

name: Teleportation
description: With this ability, you can teleport yourself to anywhere in the world.  If you've seen the movie "Jumper", you teleport in a similar fashion.  That movie was horrible, by the way.  Anyways, you might be worried about teleporting while moving, or teleporting onto a moving vehicle.  That's all taken care of.  Your teleportation ability keeps you from teleporting into situations where you could get killed.
summary: The ability to teleport yourself to any location.
strengths: Go anywhere, anytime, instantly
Never be late for work--as long as you can get your ass out of bed
You can totally mess with your friends
weaknesses: Car rides seem slow as hell
You might be considered dangerous

name: Space/Time Manipulation
description: Einstein once theorized that space and time were linked. He was right. A person with Space/Time Manipulation can slow, speed or stop time. They can also travel through time and teleport.
summary: The ability to manipulate space and time
strengths: See what really happened in all those battles
Go to all the great cities free of charge
No contest in fights
weaknesses: Takes monumental effort to use
Cannot rewrite history, as the universe protects itself and sends you back
If you touch your past self, you will die in an explosion

name: Door To Anywhere
description: With this ability you can turn any door into a portal that connect to any door of your choosing anywhere in the world. The portal closes as the door does and cannot be reopened except with this ability. This ability also applies to anything that acts like a door, including chest lids or cupboards.
summary: The ability to use any door as a portal to any other door in the world.
strengths: Go anywhere with a door
Evade enemies easily
weaknesses: Others can follow you through your portals if the door does not close.

name: Memory/Sight  Jump
description: The person with this power is able to teleport to places which he or she has been too. The person cannot jump or teleport to places they have not seen or been to. There is no distance restriction for this power. If you have seen the place or been to the place you want to go, you can go there. When they jump, they leave no traces of smoke or light whatsoever
summary: The ability to jump or teleport to places you have visited in the past
strengths: Can travel to anywhere in the world as long as you have been there
Can stop enemies who are creatures of habit.
weaknesses: Cannot go to places you have not seen or been to

name: Comic Word
description: If you say boom looking at a car it explode. If you say whoosh looking at something that thing will fly. And so on.
summary: The ability to say comic words and make them happen
strengths: No physical exhaustion.
Can be done from a safe distance.
You get to read comics!!!!!
weaknesses: If some one shuts your mouth it is useless.
Does not work with food in mouth.
Say it by mistake would activate it.

name: Shadow Walking
description:
Basically, you could walk into a shadow of an alleyway by your house, and walk out of an alleyway in Paris or something. Zing! 

Or even walk into a shadow here, and come out of a shadow on the dark side of Mars! (or any planet)

The only downside is you might get lost in the 'Shadow Realm' you have to pass through.
summary: The ability to teleport through shadows
strengths: Shadows are basically everywhere
Super-easy to walk into people's houses
Cool party trick/ good for escaping
weaknesses: You might get lost getting from place to place
If you fell into a shadow, you might end up on Mt. Everest.................
Probably not the easiest power to control

name: Enhanced Teleporting
description: The user of this ability can teleport themselves and objects through time and space. The person has to be touching the object but does not have to travel with it. The user of this ability must concentrate on the place and/or time they want to teleport to.
summary: The ability to teleport yourself and objects through time and space
strengths: The user can teleport through time
The user can teleport anywhere
weaknesses: The user can time travel but does not have any other time-controlling abilities

name: Electrical Transport
description: The user is able to travel through electrical lines , phone lines or anything that has electrical flowing through it. The traveling source must be continuous. If the line is not continuous , the user is able to remain in electrical transportation form for a 100 feet before reverting back to normal.
summary: The ability to travel using electrical lines, phones lines or anything that has electricity flowing through it.
strengths: Good mode of transportation in the cities
Good for sneaking into building or spying
weaknesses: No electrical cables in rural areas

name: Lucky Strike
description: Alter probability to make the unexpected expected. With this ability, you can be almost certain the traffic light will turn green when you get there, that you will run into certain people under very unlikely circumstances, and that the lottery numbers you picked just might beat the odds. You can manipulate probability so that, if it's unlikely, it will suddenly become the next most likely thing to happen.  What are the odds you'll win that sweepstakes to live at the playboy mansion? You decide!
summary: The ability to manipulate probability, causing unlikely things to happen or likely things not to happen.
strengths: Make amazing things very likely to happen to you
Alter the odds of someone sharting
Turn the odds in your favor
weaknesses: With all this luck it might become boring
But, it probably won't!

name: Ghosting
description: At any time you can activate any combination of the powers of invisibility, phasing, and supersonic flight (though supersonic flight requires you to be in phasing mode). You can cause other objects to be affected as well, so you can fly at supersonic speeds in a car or make you and your friends invisible. The limit on your speed is only limited by how fast you recognize the landscape.
summary: The ability to posses the perceived abilities of a ghost: phasing, invisibility, supersonic flight
strengths: Travel to any location as fast as you desire
Eavesdrop like a pro
Walls and doors: no longer a problem
weaknesses: Affecting other objects requires physical contact
Won't work while asleep or unconscious

name: Physics Distortion
description: Physics covers every physical event, so Physics Distortion is very powerful. Its users can bend natural laws to run up walls, make an object keep its energy and fly in a straight line, change the direction of flying objects, slow down time for objects, and even create a field of megaspace around themselves where space is so condensed traveling an inch in the field is like traveling a mile in our world. It is only distortion, so no natural laws may be broken. It also takes practice.
summary: The ability to bend the laws of physics for a short while
strengths: Run up walls (mess with gravity)
Slow down time for objects (mess with time)
Create condensed megaspace fields (mess with space)
weaknesses: Is only distortion, can't break any laws
Takes practice to consistently do the same thing
Only for about 1 hour consistently

name: Portal Cutter
description: Someone with this power can use any sharp object such as knives, broken glass, barbed wire, etc to create portals from one area to another. The one making the cut has to concentrate on where they want the portal to go to or the destination will be raandom. The portal will automatically close after the one who made it goes through.
summary: The ability to use sharp objects to create portals from one place to another by slashing
strengths: Perfect escape route since the portal closes when you go through.
weaknesses: Need defensive powers since you'll always be the last one to go through in a group.
Accidentally going into a war zone.

name: Artifical Intelligence Creator
description: With this power you can create your own AI. You can give the AI tasks and it will preform them with a level of speed and detail unseen in humans. They are able to learn and master skills extremely quickly. Task them to write books, make games,do your assignments for you, or play the stock market at a level of detail no human could match. They will always be loyal, unless your create one not to be. Also you cannot use your PC while they are performing a task, as they will be using it.
summary: The ability to create artifical intelligence contructs and control them
strengths: Have your AI write books, make games, produce animations
Can learn process and master information and skills for optimum results
Live off their work
weaknesses: You cannot use your PC while they work
In order to learn, they can chew though your bandwidth
The wrong people might get suspious

name: Probability Transportation
description: This ability works like this. The user wants someone to catch on fire. The ability allows him to send that person to a place were there is fire like a house on fire or the sun. This ability is not an exact science, because it sends the person to the place were likelihood of being on fire is high. It is good for sending people away and teleporting.
summary: The ability to make something happen to someone/thing by sending them to places where the likelihood is very high.
strengths: Send people or themselves away to places that you something specific to happen to them.
Teleportation application
weaknesses: Not specific on location most of the time
Might be affected by Probability Manipulation or luck based powers

name: Reality Mimicry
description: The user becomes a portal between the our normal reality and their reality. They can teleport things in and out of his reality including character in their reality. If anything from our reality stays in the user's reality for too long that thing will become part of that user's reality forever and if that thing is a super being, the user gains their powers. Reality warpers can really hurt the user. The user can be in portal form to absorb attacks safely.
summary: The ability to have the traits or become the reality in one's fantasies,
strengths: You can teleport anything in your reality through to our reality and vice versa.
Absorb attacks
Gain powers of victims
weaknesses: You can still be physical harmed when you are not in portal form.
You are very susceptible and weak against Reality Warpers.

name: Chronokinesis
description: Also called Time Manipulation or Time Control. As we all know, the power of controlling time is like having a remote control to the world. Pause it, slow it down, rewind, fast-forward and even travel through it. Not to mention, the ability to set time in a loop, in desired. Even control time around specific objects and areas. Accelerate time around objects to break them down; freeze time around enemies to immobilize them for allies; accelerate time around yourself for Superhuman Speed, and more.
summary: The ability to control the flow of time in various ways
strengths: Going back in time, you can meet your past self, possibly creating an endless army of past selves.
Speed up or slow opponents down. Also freeze people (place them in a state of stasis)
Hopping through alternate timeline to alternate timeline to see how some things can play out.
weaknesses: Be careful with that time travel. You might go too far and lose your place in time.
Careful. You might land in one timeline and think it's your own. Don't lose your grip on reality...
Enemies with Time Defiance, Hypertime Chronopathy and similar powers can serve as a foil

name: Projective Teleportation
description: This power is like telekinesis, but the objects that are moved disappear from their place and appear in another, without the user touching it and with just a mere point of a finger/hand and directing where the object will appear.
summary: The ability to move objects by bending space
strengths: When moving, the objects are more accurately to go to the user without physical interference
Unpredictable attacks, the user can teleport enemies and objects anywhere within their line of sight
No need to touch objects to teleport them.
weaknesses: The range of the power is small in scale depending on how far the user's sight is
The user cannot projectively teleport the objects or humans to other places out of their sight
The power usually would not be effective that much to users with sight problems or in the dark

name: Magical Door
description: With this power, you are able to summon a magical door which leads to any place you want to go. Wanna see another country? Locked yourself inside the house? Do you need a certain object? Do you want to find somebody? Think about the door and it will appear out of nowhere. Go through it and you'll find the thing you seek. The door leads only to places on Earth, places that exist. You can make the door disappear too, and with practice, you can create multiple ones.
summary: The ability to summon a door which can be used for teleportation
strengths: Get anywhere, anytime.
Travel around the world, meet celebrities.
weaknesses: Never open up a door that leads to the bottom of the ocean.
If there's no room for the door, it can't be summoned.

name: Castling
description: Castling is a form of teleportation where you exchange your location with someone else's. You switch places. It gets its name from the Chess move where the Rook and King simultaneously - The King moves into a safer location, and the Rook moves into a more dangerous area where it can either defend the king or take a more active, aggressive role.
summary: The ability to teleport and exchange locations with another individual
strengths: If you are in danger, exchange places with your foe
If ally is in danger, exchange places with them to protect them
weaknesses: Make sure you know where you are teleporting into or else there can be trouble
May exchange locations and one or both of you may not be able to deal with the new problems

name: Glossa
description: Speak any language without having to learn it. For instance if you wanted to travel to France but can't speak it, with this power you'll be unstoppable.
summary: The ability to speak any language without having to learn it.
strengths: You can vist those places you've always wanted to go.
You'd get an A+ in Spanish, French, Chinese or whatever your taking.
Don't need years of training!
weaknesses: You can't turn it off

name: Speed
description: Speed will allow the user to run on water as his quick footwork avoids breaking apart the water's surface tension; run up walls before gravity takes its toll; vibrate molecules so fast that light fails to reflect them off, rendering him invisible. Further vibrations will allow your molecules to vibrate in their fixed positions above the speed of sound, allowing the body to move faster than Mach 4. Pushing the limits even further will cause the body to move at light speed, perhaps faster.
summary: The ability to move at high speeds capable of passing through the barrier of light.
strengths: Running around the world 7 times in a sec (light speed) to deliver a matter-shattering punch.
Enjoy the wind and freedom of speed.
Quick reactions to dodge allowing yourself no harm.
weaknesses: Need to train the perception of speed to avoid splattering innocent bystanders
Requires high stamina to run long distances.
Try not to trip. XD
tags: Speed Jet Sonic Burst Pistol Gattling Gun

name: Time Travel
description: A Time Traveler doesn't need a DeLorean or special chair to navigate the timeline. The only thing they require is a bit of focus to travel through time. They have less restrictions on their power than a Space-Time Manipulator; time travel takes less out of them, they can interact with their past and future selves, and they can even influence present events by messing with the past. However, they cannot teleport.
summary: The ability to move forward and backward in time
strengths: Requires moderate focus
Can interact with past and future selves
Can influence present events by going into the past
weaknesses: Cannot teleport
Fighting your future self
May change future for worse

name: Power Adaptation
description: If you get thrown from a building, you are probably thinking ''oh crap'' right? Nope! With this power you'll probably get the power to fly or wall crawl or teleport to save yourself. If a car is falling on you, you'll probably get superstrength or time stop of superspeed to get out of the way.
summary: The ability to get a random power to help you in the specific moment
strengths: The powers you use in the moment you keep
They might be really good powers
weaknesses: You only get to keep five powers so once you get power #5 you stop adapting

name: Superhuman Speed
description: Superhuman speedsters can run at speeds of up to Mach 1 for extended periods. Their thinking processes, hand movements, eye motion, and reaction times are similarily faster. These energies are fueled by either massive amounts of food or an absorption state during sleep.
summary: The ability to move at above-human speeds
strengths: Never be late
Have fun in dodgeball
Thievery
weaknesses: Need to eat all the time
Normal life seems slow
May be kidnapped by FBI and studied

name: Time Dilation
description: While the user is unable to stop time, they can make time go slower for themselves. When activated, everything else moves very, very slowly compared to the user. In effect, other people think you are moving at high speeds. You also avoid most problems of super speed, such as friction. You can move things in slowed time, but things you touch will react with the relative speed in real time. You can also make other people faster with this power if so desired.
summary: The ability to make time go slower relative to the user
strengths: Great for daily life-do things at a leisurely pace
The next best thing to time stop
Make attacks too slow to matter
weaknesses: The user cannot dilate time to get more sleep
The power only works on yourself and things you touch, but does not work on machines
If you get stabbed from behind while using this power, your death will be slow and painful

name: Shadow Portals
description: You can disappear into a shadow and move from one shadow to another while remaining unseen.
summary: The ability to not be seen when in shadows and to teleport to other shadows.
strengths: No limit to how long you can use it
Can go from place to place as long as a shadow is there
weaknesses: People will know that you're gone
Drains your energy

name: Light Jump
description: With this power when you jump your body turns into light and you appear in another location of your choosing that is in a straight line from the direction that you jumped. This power can be activated while in midair just by moving your feet. You must know where you are jumping to before you can change into light and you can not jump to a solid area, such as jumping inside a wall. There is a three second cool down for this power between jumps.
summary: The ability to jump in a flash of light and appear in another area.
strengths: Jump to any location as long as you know where it is.
You move at the speed of light.
You can jump again in mid air just by moving your feet.
weaknesses: Only works in a straing line in direction you jumped.
You must know where you are jumping too.
Has a three second cool down.

name: Teleportation Imbuing
description: With this ability, the user can make an item, such as a watch, teleport the holder to your current location with a selected action, e.g. rubbing it. Alternately, you can make it teleport you to an object. The user can also control the objects and render them normal. The owner of the ability decides whether the object travels with the user. There are no energy or time requirements for the ability.
summary: The ability to make teleporting objects.
strengths: Make infinite teleporters.
Never need public transport or a car again.
Can give a "Trojan Horse" gift to an enemy.
weaknesses: Can't travel through time.
Have to be in a desired location.
Others can use the item (could be a pro).

name: Aero Augmentation
description: This power allows you to enhance how you interact with one force of air (lift, thrust, drag, weight), and devalue its counter force. Lift makes you lighter allowing levitation, thrust makes you faster, drag makes you slower (useful if you need to make an immediate stop), and weight (gravity) makes you heavier. This power is very useful for aerial combat.
summary: The ability to change how you interact with the forces of air
strengths: Combining thrust and lift allows you to fly (not levitate, actual flight)
You can achieve super speed and flight
weaknesses: Not an ability meant for combat (doesn't mean you can't though)
No defensive abilities

name: Phase Diver
description: A person with this power has the ability to turn any solid they touch into its liquid state or any liquid they touch into its solid state. Obviously this power can be used in many creative ways. Some examples include going through liquid walls. Trapping people by pulling them into cement and then hardening it.
summary: The ability to turn solids into liquids or liquids into solids by touch
strengths: Solids into liquids - Swim on land, go through walls,
Liquids into solids - Trap people in swimming pools
Everything that changed state will start to revert to previous shapes and have the same temperature
weaknesses: You still need to breath when swimming through any liquid

name: Child Of The Night
description: The ability to grow claws and be able to run at God-like speeds during the night. Once the sun rises, you become a regular person. This power is inherited through genetics. Running in the night is like a drug for the Children of the Night and produces extreme pleasure. Direct contact with the sunlight could cause slight discomfort. The Children of the Sun are your enemies.
summary: The ability to grow claws, be able to run at God-like speeds, and be almost invincible during the night
strengths: Become an insanely powerful creature of the night
Feel the icy wind against your body as you run through the night
Be able to eliminate any enemies
weaknesses: If you are in the middle of a battle and the sun comes up, you are screwed
The sun slightly causes you to be discomfortable
The Children of the Sun are powerful while you are a weak human

name: Wing Manifestation
description: The user of this power is able to grow wings that can be used for flying. However, the wings that are grown is dependent on what animal or insect with wings which are near the user. For example, if there is a bald eagle near by, you would get a wing structure of a bald eagle. The wings that are manifested are proportianate to the user's size and will enable them to fly
summary: The ability to grow wings that can be used for flight
strengths: The user can with limits depending on the type of wing
Can defend against rear attack
weaknesses: Not independent flight, air and thrust is still needed
Defect or injury to wing may cause flight to be erratic

name: Sports Week
description: On Monday, you are an excellent football (soccer) player. On Tuesday, you are an excellent basketball player. On Wednesday, you are an excellent roller skater. On Thursday, you are an excellent gymnast. On Friday, you are an excellent swimmer. On Saturday, you are an excellent golfer. And on Sunday, you are an excellent tennis player. However, you will only be good at these sports during the indicated day, your capacities will be back to normal on the other days.
summary: The ability to be extremely good at certain sports on certain days of the week.
strengths: You will be excellent even if you don't have the right anatomy for it.
The date is the one of the time zone you're in.
Being excellent at a sport also means coming up with great strategies and being a good teacher.
weaknesses: If a match you're playing on a good day is reported to the day after.
You will only be good at these seven sports. You can't change them.
You will only be good for one day per week.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Reflective Teleportation
description: With contact, the user can easily move from a mirror, a puddle of water, a tile or anything else that they can see themselves in to any other reflective surface in existence.
summary: The ability to teleport from any reflective surface to another reflective surface.
strengths: Can easily be almost anywhere
Water can be enough of a reflective surface to teleport through
weaknesses: Moving surfaces create problems
You may not know where you are
Some places lack reflective surfaces

name: Kinetic Deflection
description: Your body is surrounded with an impenetrable force field. When kinetic force is exerted onto you, say a bullet shot at you, the force field absorbs that exerted force energy & deflects it with a greater kinetic force. So that bullet shot at you bounces off you & shot another way with greater momentum. Making it a super bullet. This is also applied to attacks. Sending the assailant flying back.
summary: The ability to create impenetrable force field that deflects any exerted kinetic force with greater power
strengths: Nigh invunerable
weaknesses: Your exerted force is not amplified

name: Orb
description: It is called orbing. You can orb out of the room or across the world. You can stand in front of a book, hold out your hand and say "book" and tada! It's in your hand.
summary: The ability to teleport in a flash of blue sparkles. You can also teleport items toward you.
strengths: Go almost anywhere.
Get things that are out of reach.
Doesn't waste time with walking.
weaknesses: Anti-Orb spell will cancel out the effect.
Needs time to master.

name: Optical Reality Negation
description: With this power, one has the ability to negate/destroy reality within their line of sight. This power can be used to destroy specific parts of an object or the entire structure in general. You can also bounce your power's optical aspect off of reflective surfaces.
summary: The ability to destroy anything that is within your line of sight.
strengths: You can easily win staredowns.
You are dangerous around mirrors.
Anything you see is an easy target.
weaknesses: You are limited by the range of your sight.
Any obscured object can not be destroyed.
You will become mentally exhausted after over use.

name: Warp Speed
description: One with this ability can run so fast, that they jump from this dimension or time, to another. You can jump from here to the past, to the future or to an alternate reality (and then jump back). Too bad, you can't use this power for regular superspeed (you automatically accelerate to warp speed).
summary: The ability to run with such great speed that one jumps from this dimension/time to another
strengths: Run incredibly fast
Jump into different dimensions
Jumpt into different times
weaknesses: Can only use this power for travel (unless you maybe smack your enemy on the way out)
Have to have enough room to move (if you don't, you'll bump into stuff before you can warp)
People who can travel to different dimensions can try to follow you

name: Call Of The Olympians
description: You have the incredible power to have the abilities of any Greek god. This includes the Twelve Olympians and the minor gods. You can only call upon one god's power at a time. You don't summon the god to you, just their power, such as the speed of Hermes, the intelligence of Athena, or the ability to control the skies like Zeus, you get the idea. Once you call upon one god's power, the one you are possessing goes away.
summary: The ability to call upon the power of the Olympians in your time of need.
strengths: You can have the power of the Greek gods.
You can have many powers.
You can call upon the major and minor Greek gods.
weaknesses: You can only have one god's power at a time.

name: Portal Phasing
description: To portal phase you must touch the object you are phasing through. The object must be wider than the person, or else, the object phases through the person. When phasing out of an object, you can phase out of any side of that object or anything touching that object. Owners of this power can't phase through people.
summary: The ability to phase into an object and out of any side of it or any other object touching it.
strengths: Getting to other places is faster
Thanks to gravity every inanimate object is touching the ground
There is no place you can escape from
weaknesses: The power doesn't work if the owner is evil
The owner of this power shouldn't have other powers
If you have other powers, you age quicker

name: Dark Matter
description: Dark matter is a form of matter unlike any other. No light can pass through it at all. This ability allows you to create and control the dark stuff. When you make it,it will appear as a black cloud/smoke. You can then use it for a variety of effects. You could make a shield against light based powers. And by surrounding something with it you could move the target. Also with time you could surround your self with it(not your head)and fly. Dark matter also has many other unique properties.
summary: The ability to create and control dark matter
strengths: You can control one of the most dangerous forms of matter known to man
You can use it to move stuff, make a shield, fly,etc.
Dark matter has many unknown properties for you to discover and put to use
weaknesses: Dark matter isn't totally solid so moving things will take practice.
You can't use it as a sheild for anything but light
You can control one of the most dangerous forms of matter known to man

name: Speed Reading
description: If you never have time to read, you can just touch a book and immediately know every word.
summary: The ability to memorize an entire book just by touching it
strengths: You can read through an entire library in a half hour (instead of the normal year)
You'll be the smartest kid in your school
Never have to read at a normal pace again
weaknesses: Yeah, right!

name: Expressive Makeup
description: You have the ability to be a wonderful makeup artist. Except that the makeup you apply will be a reflection of the person's feelings at the moment of application. For example, if the person feels shy, you will generally apply pink or reddish powder on their cheeks. If the person feels sad, you can either draw clown tears on their face or apply a runny mascara under their eyes. If the person feels angry, you will reinforce their expression by drawing expressive traits and darkening their face.
summary: The ability to reveal a person's feeling of the moment when you apply makeup on their face.
strengths: You're a great visual and emotional artist.
It reflects the exact emotion the person is feeling at the moment you create the makeup.
You can also use it on yourself to reveal your emotion to the world!
weaknesses: You need cosmetics and makeup to use this power.
You can't apply the makeup the way you want to; it will ALWAYS reflect the person's emotion.
The expression you will draw the most will be "hey! what the heck do you think you're doing?"
tags: was edited as it was just a unimaginative combination of two unrelated powers

name: Daily Reset
description: With this power you are able to go to sleep at the end of the day (for example) and wake up when you first did that day and relive that day a second time. This power can only be used once per day, so therefore you only get two runs of that day, the first initial run and the second when you use the power. Your memory remains normal. In order for the power to work, you must fall asleep before the end of the day (midnight) if not the power does not work.
summary: The ability to fall asleep and wake up when you first woke that day.
strengths: Relive every day twice.
Win every race, bet and lottery, dominate the stock market.
Always have a second chance within the immediate future.
weaknesses: Your ability to exploit this power is based on your memory.
You must fall sleep within 24 hours of waking up, if you doze off after midnight then you go to the next day, also not great if you have trouble getting to sleep.
You might get disorientated and lose track which run through you are on for that day.

name: Commander In Chief
description: You can command anyone or anything to do anything! Just say the word and any object or person will do as you say if it is within their capabilites. For example, if someone can't read Arabic, you can't command them to, and you can't tell a car to fly away, but you can tell it to drive you wherever you want.
summary: The ability to command anyone or anything to do what as you say, within their capabalities
strengths: Always getting your way
Anything or anyone under your control
weaknesses: Your command has to be within the person or object's natural capabilities.
Could be worshipped by others

name: Power Of The Epic Heroes
description: You have the strength of a hundred men, five times the speed of a cheetah, the ability to fly two times faster than a falcon.
summary: The ability to become a superhuman
strengths: Fly
Speed
Strength
weaknesses: Not original
Dangerous when not controlled

name: Jack Of All Trades
description: Your washing machine breaks down, wish you were a plumber? Lights on the fritz and wish you could re-wire the house? With this power just think of the problem and you can instantly learn skills to solve it, become a carpenter, architect,cook, martial artist you name it. More than just knowledge, this power makes you feel well-practiced at the art. Be a one-man maintenance crew, but you can only have a few skill sets running at once, dependant on their complexity.
summary: The ability to do what it says on the tin, learn any and every skill
strengths: Never have to call the handy-man again, save money
Build or sabotage your way out of most problems
Easy to get work
weaknesses: Can only run a certain number of skill sets at a given time
Could become confused between skills if they are similar and both active
Doesn't neccesarily arm you with the tools and materials you may need

name: Doorman
description: This power allows you to create, control & manipulate multiple teleportals that allows your whole self or your body parts or other people & objects to cross to another area instantly. Think of the power that Spider-Man's villain The Spot has. If you are at A & B is in the way of C, the portals allows you to bypass B all together. But be careful, making & controlling the holes takes concentration, you have to close them or they could become black holes.
summary: The ability to create wormhole portals to travel instantly through
strengths: Create & control wormholes
Teleport your self or your body parts or anything else vast distances instantly
weaknesses: Creating & controlling the portals takes effort
Have to close the portals after using them or could become potential uncontrolable black holes

name: Mathematical Manipulation
description: With this power, 1 plus 1 equals 3! This power enables you to manipulate mathematics within a radius of 50 metres. The entire logic of math is changed with this power, and it will make complete sense, no matter how absurd. And get this: You can change what happens in reality by messing up math! For example: Moth flying times (speed of moth plus mass of your lunch)equals moth growing larger! And afterwards, you can revert maths back to its normal, logical self. 5 minus 3 equals 56!
summary: The ability to manipulate mathematics
strengths: Change the rules of mathematics, so what wouldn't normally make sense is absolutely correct!
Radius of 50 metres, and reversible.
Change trajectories, angles, aims, people's minds, etc.
weaknesses: You might want to know a lot about math, so that there is more for you to warp.
You might not want to reverse the effects, but sadly you have to.
People might not get this power

name: Mirror Manipulation
description: The person with this power is able to manipulate the properties as well as reflection of mirrors. This means that the user of this power is able to travel or teleport using mirrors, trap their enemies inside mirrors in a mirror dimension as well as conjure up illusions with mirrors
summary: The ability to manipulate the reflection as well as the properties of mirrors
strengths: Can travel using mirrors, that are almost everywhere in the city
Can trap enemies in a dimension inside the mirrors
Can conjure up illusion in mirrors to confuse enemies
weaknesses: If there are no mirrors around, this power doesnt work

name: Speed Of Light
description: Smoke your frinds. Save the day.  Run at the speed of light!
summary: The ability to run incredibly fast
strengths: save the day
smoke your frinds
make new friends
weaknesses: hurting people
creating wind storms

name: Gift: Speed
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at moving at high speeds than other beings. Thus their speed-based powers are faster than most other being's powers and it is harder to slow them down. However, someone with this power can only recieve speed-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at high speed movement
strengths: Almost no one is as fast as someone with this power.
Speed-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only speed-based powers now.

name: Spectre
description: With this power you can change to a ghost and back, it is instant. As a ghost you will appear translucent but you will keep your human shape, you will appear as if you are underwater. Anything you are touching will became ghostly too, including clothes & weapons. You can have weapons & bullets phase right through you, they will slow down slightly due to the fact you have slight mass. While in ghost form, you can phase through anything and breathe underwater. When changing back, wounds all heal.
summary: The ability to turn into a ghost along with anything else you touch.
strengths: No prison can hold you.
Indestructable unless caught by suprise.
Never ever leaving the keys indoors again.
weaknesses: Might make you a social outcast.
Won't shield you if sniped or caught by suprised.
Turning it off while in a wall will kill you.

name: Anywhere Flight
description: This power allows you to fly anywhere as fast as you want--even in space--by forming an air filled, pressurized force field around you. The force field needs at least minor concentration to maintain.
summary: The ability to fly at any speed, anywhere.
strengths: Fly in water, space, anywhere!
Always have breathable air
Fly as fast as you want.
weaknesses: Can get lost.
Force field won't work if you don't pay attention to it.
Force field can only stop minor physical damage.

name: Rune Master
description: You are able to create a ring of runes around you which give you different powers. There is one for each elements, summoning, flying, destruction, creating, invisibility, strength, speed, and one for wishes. All you need to do to use a power is touch the rune and you are able to use that power for three and a half hours, except for the wish one which stays in effect for a year. While the powers are in effect, there is a rune on the back of your hand so you know you still have the power.
summary: The ability to create a circle-like wall of light around you that has runes on it which give you powers
strengths: You can have many powers
You are able to summon creatures to your aid
You can fly
weaknesses: Might mix up the runes
Could forget which rune stands for which power
You can only use the wish rune three times a month

name: Multiverse Code Master
description: You can create a code that, when spoken aloud, allows one to go to a parallel universe. You can create as many codes as you want, and deactivate unwanted ones, though you don't have any special knowledge of what one is being used for. As for choosing the destination (both what universe to go to and where in the universe they appear), what the code allows through, what the portal/transportation/whatever looks like, etc. , you design that when you make the code.
summary: The ability to manipulate codes allowing one to go into alternate universes
strengths: The power to travel through alternate realities, and you can give it to friends and revoke it
You could give everyone a unique code, so you can cut people off when you want
It can be very limited (one way to random universe), or extremely open (anywhere to anywhere)
weaknesses: Someone evil could get a code, and you might never know about it
Someone can force you to make a code for them, and then kill you or take your power
Someone could force you to disable all the codes, and then kill you or take your power

name: Unfettered
description: The unfettered ability is a form of probability manipulation and is emotionally activated. So long as the user perceives himself as free, there is no obstacle capable of hindering his progress. Shackles fall off, locked doors fail, paths are always open to the user, and foes fail to hinder or kill the user. Speed and constant motion enhance the effect; a full sprint will make an almost straight path to the destination, while walking makes a winding but inevitable path to the same destination.
summary: The ability to reach any destination regardless of obstacles.
strengths: Cannot be detained or hindered, and can never get lost.
Can smuggle or carry a parcel with near complete certainty.
Paths can be made for allies who can keep up to pierce security or enemy lines.
weaknesses: Feelings of abstract captivity (ultimatums, paradoxes, etc.) can dampen or nullify the effect.
The power only affects the journey. If the user is not in transit, he is not protected.
Paths can be followed by foes who can keep up.

name: Eloscity
description: The odd defining quality however is that your body becomes a combination of elasticity and supersonic speed, you are adapted towards the rigors of flexibility, coordination and able to move at extremely fast speeds, much faster than any vehicle etc. , and you can even run on water or exceed the speed of sound, without getting injured when beyond the natural limits of the human body. You can also contort yourself into any shape you choose faster in a blink of an eye.
summary: The ability to stretch, deform, expand your limbs and body to super-human high speeds.
strengths: Can stretch and run over vast distances, faster than the speed of sound (770 miles per hour).
You can deform yourself for offensive or defensive purposes.
weaknesses: Can contort yourself into various positions and sizes, although this is painful and difficult.
Extremely odd and difficult for people to see.

name: Spectral Chains
description: You can create chains with your soul. The chains are made of soulerite, a metal as hard as diamond. You can control the chains as if they were your own limbs, you can fire them at sound speed. Once outside your body, the chains move at a normal speed. When separated from your body, the chain will disappear in 2 hours.  You can also spin the chains arround your body to become a living chainsaw which is useful to travel, cut things, ect.
summary: The ability to create chains that you can control.
strengths: Good in defensive and offensive.
Chains are released by thought.
Incredible strength
weaknesses: Chains are affected by metal controlling skills and magnetism.
Cut chains only last for 2 hours

name: Spectral Mimicry
description: All the fun of being a ghost, none of the pain of dying. At will, a Spectral Mimic's body can become weightless, translucent and immaterial. They can also become invisible, but this takes more active concentration. While in spectral form, they cannot be touched or touch anyone. They can't see or control the dead.
summary: The ability to mimic the form and abilities of a ghost
strengths: Can float and fly
Automatically translucent, can become invisible
Immaterial
weaknesses: Cannot touch anyone in spectral form
Invisibility takes more concentration
Cannot see or control dead

name: Speed Control
description: Speed control allows you to speed people up to bullet time or down to a crawl. Though you can effect the speed of people, this does not apply to time itself so inanimate objects move in real time.
summary: The ability to effect the speed of other people.
strengths: Move faster than other people
Get things done faster
Speed up anything unpleasent
weaknesses: Only effects living creatures
Time stays the same
Can make people power hungry

name: Automatic Secondary Powers
description: This is needed for lots of reasons: If you had super strength then you would need anchoring powers to stop you from being pushed back while trying to push a large object or falling into the ground if you lift on up. If you had super speed you would need to be able to withstand the massive friction and the pressure of the wind stopping you. If you had the power of flight then you would need to be able to deal with the thinner atmosphere the higher up you go. Etcetera, etcetera.
summary: The ability to gain any secondary power necessary
strengths: It can decrease the amount of cons
Very useful to have this power if you have a potentually self-harming power
weaknesses: Enemies with these powers can become very hard to defeat
These would be bad if you wanted to commit suicide with your powers.

name: Speed Serum
description: Have you ever wanted to temporarily have super speed or give others super speed? Well now you can with this power you always have a syringe that is full of speed serum, a red liquid that when injected into somebody gives them the power to move at incredible speeds for three days. There is no way to make the effects of the serum permanent and once it wears off you have to wait a period of three days before injecting yourself again. If you do not wait three days in between injections you will die.
summary: The ability to create a speed serum
strengths: You can give yourself or anybody else super speed for three days
You can have super speed for three days
You can summon the syringe whenever you want and if you lose it you can just summon it again
weaknesses: You only have it for three days
You have to wait three days after it wears off before you inject yourself again
If you don't wait the three days you die (so if you inject your enemies twice in one day they die)

name: Eternel (Undying)
description: Survive in any environment including space and the arctic, and high speed regeneration from any attack, even those that reduce you to nothing; however those kind of attacks cause regeneration to be longer. Only for roach hybrids.
summary: The ability to survive in any environment in addition to everything
strengths: High speed regeneration
Nigh indestructable
Can survive anything
weaknesses: Have to eat a huge amount of the closest edible source nearby
Regeneration is incredible painful
Still effected by weather; for example being frozen, but will still survive

name: Light Travel
description: In essence, this is like teleportation, but more limited. Anywhere there is light, you can meld into it and emerge anywhere else there is light. You essentially move at the speed of light.
summary: The ability to travel through light.
strengths: You can travel quickly.
You can escape easily.
weaknesses: It's more limited than teleportation.
It can be difficult to perform.

name: Time Breath
description: From the second you stop breathing (unless dead) to the time you breath in or out time will stand still except for you.
summary: The ability to stop time by holding your breath
strengths: Play pranks
Steal stuff
Cheat
weaknesses: Lung capasity is an issue
Kissing and swimming would be awkward
Most Machines don't work (bicycles would)

name: Time Dilation Manipulation
description: You can create Time Dilation Fields. These are areas where time flows differently. You could create a room of extremely slowed time to go to the future, accelerate/pause time around you to go super-fast, make paused time to 'teleport', stopped time to prevent a bomb from going off, or create a non-mobile accelerated time field around someone to age them to death. Creating a field that goes in REVERSE may be possible, but it'll take years of practice to develop.
summary: The ability to manipulate areas of altered time
strengths: Includes a lot of other powers. Super-speed, teleportation (in a way), aging.
You could also make "force fields" by creating an area of stopped time, where nothing could move.
There's also time travel to the future, though getting back is a pain, if possible at all.
weaknesses: Momentum. You will hate this concept after you create thousands of dollars of collateral damage.
If you're not careful with your fields, parts of you (or your allies) might age differently...
Or even be seperated by moving in different timeframes. Oh, and you're going to age really fast.

name: Ctrl + Z
description: With this power, you have the ability to un-do things when you screw them up. You can correct any mistake by traveling to the past up to 5 seconds. You can only do it once each time you screw up. It is similar to the computer, when you make a mistake, you hit CTRL + Z and everything is un-done.
summary: The ability to un-do things.
strengths: You never screw-up.
You can do things over again.
You have more control over your life.
weaknesses: You can make terrible mistakes.
You don't live your life fully.
You can become very obsessive.

name: Flight Manipulation
description: With this ability, you can access the power of flight in its entirety. That means that the user is able to direct his flight in any direction (forward, backward, side to side, and at whatever velocity the user desires); in addition, the user can also control the flight patterns of OTHER flying things. Fortunately, when the user flies, his mind subliminally keeps him from going any faster than his body would be able to handle. UNfortunately, this same limit does not apply to others.
summary: The ability to control your own and others' flight patterns
strengths: Access the power of (wingless) flight, and control the motion of other flying subjects
Your body will never let you go faster than you can handle
Others can be made to fly as fast as you want them to go (or to stop midair, etc. )
weaknesses: Can't control things incapable of flight (unless they are already in the air)
Can't send a subject INTO flight (can't MAKE people capable of flight)
No "terminal-velocity detection" is present in certain people (go faster than you can handle)

name: Quietus Jump
description: Teleport directly into any living organism around you. The effects of jumping into the living depends on the proximity at which you teleport & the size of the thing you jump from. Things smaller than what you jump from are instantly decimated. The closer a living thing is to you the more damage you do. If at arms length you kill-jump. Farther away you may initially stun, if you finally learn to jump into bodies without killing you possess them, gaining knowledge, abilities etc.
summary: The ability to teleport into living things for possession, damage, or the kill-jump
strengths: You can teleport into any living thing in your area. (32 kilometer radius)
May steal bodies when you jump into them. All their knowledge, talents and abilities are yours.
Highly effective: At the least you render victims comatose, deaths are more likely
weaknesses: If you stay in a body too long it will begin to deteriorate and you will be forced to jump
Once you activate this power you will have no body of your own, jump 'til you die
If bodiless, jump into a body into a body in 60 sec or you are an ethereal afterthought

name: Mirror World
description: You can just simply walk into a mirror, preferably your height & you'll enter the Mirror World. A dimension of traveling mirrors you can cross through. Though if you have words on your clothes, when you exit, they will appear reversed. Also small mirrors like compact are not really usable accept maybe spying through & using cracked/broken mirrors will could shatter & destroy you into a million pieces.
summary: The ability to use mirrors as traveling dimensions
strengths: Use mirrors as a instant transporter
Use mirrors as spy devices
weaknesses: Words on your clothing will be backwards when you exit mirrors
Small mirrors are just really used for spying
Traveling through cracked/broken mirrors will kill you

name: Acquired Total Immunity
description: With this ability, a multi-powered superbeing is unaffected or granted total immunity against all superpower they are in possession of, e.g. if you have telekinesis, flight, reality manipulation, immunity, and immortality, all these superpowers will have no effect against you or your abilities. Telekinesis will be unable to move you or anything near you, flight is nullified. Reality manipulation? Immunity and immortality? Forget it! As long as you have the ability, it will not affect you.
summary: The ability to become immune or to be completely unaffected by any other ability through its acquisition.
strengths: If you have access to multiple superpowers. (Yey superpowerlist! )
If you are a power copier, stealer, or absorber.
If a superpower is a threat to you, all you have to do is acquire it. It's just a click away.
weaknesses: If your enemy possesses deadly abilities different from what you have.
If you are not a power copier, stealer, or absorber and you have no access to the superpowerlist.
This doesn't work against the ability 'Author's Immunity'.

name: Transparency
description: The power transparency, also known as Opacity Control, gives the user the ability to control any objects or person's opacity. They can make things opaque, translucent, and transparent at will. With this power it is very easy to fool other people and hide your true power. For example you can fake hammerspace, forcefields, flying, and super human speed, just to name a few. In addition, the user ,through training, can make anything invisible once shown--such as hiding blood from opened wounds.
summary: The ability to control an object's opacity from opaque to translucent to transparent
strengths: Can make anything invisibile including yourself
Immunity to lasers and light based attacks--light passes through you or said transparent object
Excellent for magician, mimes, and illusionists and assassins
weaknesses: You need to train in order to control how opaque you want something to be
Once someone finds out your trick it is a lot easier to beat you
Things that you don't know the location of cannot be made transparent

name: Superhuman Acceleration
description: A person with this power can accelerate to their max speed quickly. This does not give the user superspeed. This can be useful as a sort of pseudo super speed that can be used in short bursts.
summary: The ability to reach your maximum speed in a very short amount of time
strengths: Can be used to win races either for a head start or finishing strong
Combined with superhuman speed you have an edge on other speeders
Can even surprise actual speeders who don't expect you to suddenly go that fast
weaknesses: Takes up stamina to use

name: Thermochemical Energy
description: Thermo: heat. Chemical: chemical. Thermochemical: an explosive, fiery form of energy. A person with Thermochemical Energy is a natural thermochemic dynamo, able to release it at will in order to: fly at jet speeds, throw thermochemic punches, and even protect themselves from harm. However, it takes a while to get the hang of, and it demands a lot of concntration and energy of the user.
summary: The ability to release large amounts of thermochemical energy
strengths: Can fly at jet speeds
Throw thermochemic punches
Can protect yourself from harm
weaknesses: Takes a while to get the hang of it
Demands concentration
Demands energy

name: Lightning Riding
description: this power allows someone to use lightning as transportation as well as to summon it to strike at will.to use this power the rider simply summons lightning to strike him/her self they then contol where it goes. this allows them to travel at great speeds to great distances. they can also summon the lightning to strike any target at will.
summary: The ability to "ride" and summon bolts of lightning
strengths: travel at great speeds
summon lightning
immunity to all types of electicity and heat
weaknesses: eye protection needed while riding
can only summon lightning while outside
must wear protective clothing

name: Wings
description: You get to fly as fast as a peregrine falcon with its wings, or the hovering of a hummingbird's. You could retract it, but who would want that? Oh, and be sure to uncover your shoulder blades; you wouldn't want those wings to rip your shirt, would you? A good knowledge of some birds would help.
summary: The ability to have (almost) any type of wings you want.
strengths: You get to fly to work/school/that business meeting/whatever
Totally nail that part of the angel from that Broadway play
No more Maine-to-Florida-round-trip fees!
weaknesses: Have to go bare-shoulder-blade
Might be scouted for advertisements
Can't get metal wings, plastic wings... Etc.

name: Infinity Manipulation
description: If you have this power and good concentration, you can banish objects to infinity. You can wrap infinity around yourself and have any incoming attacks go into infinity. You still need to breathe, so poisonous gases will affect you. You can 'infinity-jump' anywhere that is within your line of sight instantly. You can travel to infinity yourself at will. Infinity itself is actually a bizarre dimension that can be affected by other dimensional powers or traveled to with dimension travel.
summary: The ability to manifest and manipulate infinity itself.
strengths: Any damage-including that of nuclear explosion-goes into infinity.
A short range infinity-jump ability.
Sending dangerous objects and people to infinity.
weaknesses: Someone can kill you with poisonous gases.
This power needs concentration.
This power has no offensive abilities.

name: Matter Teleportation
description: One can teleport anything within reasonable size from one known location to another, as long as that object is not human.
summary: The ability to teleport non-human matter.
strengths: One can transfer any object to or from a location.
One can disarm an opponet from a distance
Carrying anything is unecessary, as one can walk to a location and teleport it there.
weaknesses: Larger objects require more effort
Does not work on humans.
You must know exactly where the object you want to teleport is.

name: Overshadow
description: You can take over a person and be see through but not invisible.
summary: The ability to take over people's bodies
strengths: Can make enemies humiliate themselves
Make a person you like tell the other they are with you
weaknesses: If power turns off you'll be in the body forever!
Might overpower you and make you its slave
Only last when you use it too much

name: Gravitational Resistance
description: The power to be immune to gravity so you can jump and not have to come down, fly, walk on air and you have a very slim chance of falling.
summary: The ability to be immune to gravity.
strengths: You can fly.
weaknesses: If someone shoots you, you can still die.

name: Celtic Invocation: Cernunnos
description: By calling on the power of Cernunnos, by invoker has power over all beasts and birds. The invoker may take the form of any animal, as long as they've been seen before, even if by a picture. At higher levels, they may even change other people. The invoker may also command animals, as long as it doesn't over-ride their instincts. You can't ask a turtle to fly, or a cat to kill itself. The commands must act within their normal personality.
summary: The ability to call on the power of Cernunnos, the Horned God.
strengths: Fly like a butterfly, sting like a bee, but for real.
You're loved by all beasts.
You're highly respected among all invokers.
weaknesses: You can't talk to the animals, only command or take their shape.
You can't command or change into mythical creatures.
You might have stong urges to become vegan, or extremely carnivorous.

name: Timeline Hopping
description: At will, you can jump to an alternate timeline, by focusing on something in your present timeline that could have gone differently, and then going to the timeline where it was/is different. This takes a significant amount of time to perform (about ten minutes), but can take you to just about any timeline. With practise, you can shorten the required 10 minutes with leaps and bounds. You'll always remeber you're original timeline os you can get back.
summary: The ability to travel to alternate timelines
strengths: Escape danger to an alternate timeline
Gather supplies from an alternate timeline
Live out dreams or figure out what could have been
weaknesses: You can be sent to another timeline if someone has Temporal Destination Control

name: Second Best
description: Instantly gain the knowledge, skill and understanding of any task you attempt at the level of world's second best. You could be the world's second best chef, or the world's second best fly fisherman, or the world's second best lover, or the world's second best fighter pilot, ect. (this power does not change physical attributes or grant additional superpowers. You may know how to be the world's second best runner, but you will not instantly become as fast as the world's second best runner. )
summary: The ability to be the second best in the world at any given task for the duration of the attempt at the task
strengths: Fix anything! Win at carnival games! Pick locks! Hack a computer!
Pilot anything! Sell tupperware! Paint award winning paintings! Write a novel!
Win at chess! Diffuse an explosive! Win at dance competitions! Do your own taxes!
weaknesses: Does not give you the strength or speed that usually would accompany things like martial arts.
