name: Speed Of Darkness
description: You run as fast as darkness, and everyone knows darkness is faster than light, thats why theres a void of darkness.   You ignore collision because your body, clothes and equipment will become a shadow who can penetrate anything while running.  While running everything becomes slow motion for you.
summary: The ability to move as fast at darkness
strengths: Ignore collision
Faster than light
Get to places in a blink of an eye
weaknesses: You may run too fast and fall down a cliff or any high places by accident

name: Multiverse Travel Knowledge
description: You know how travel to parallel universes works, and how to do it. You will be able to build, with parts from just about anywhere (at least with fairly modern technology), any sort of machine you can imagine that allows one to travel to an alternate universe/reality/timeline. It could be handheld, a vehicle, cybernetic (only if that tech is available, though). It can vary from creating a one-way portal once to one world, to jumping to anywhere inside of any universe you choose.
summary: The ability to know how to build machines to travel the multiverse
strengths: You can travel to any alternate universe, and be able to give others machines to do it
Or teach worlds how to do it
You can go meet fictional characters, get fictional weapons, whatever you can think of
weaknesses: If your machine breaks somewhere with little or no technology, or with a hostile populace
Someone can steal your machines, or figure out how they work
Or stick bamboo under your nails until you tell them how it all works

name: Shadow Manipulation
description: Shadow Manipulation is a rare ability not to be confused with Shadow or Shadow clones. Shadow energy is a power source that can only be past from 1 shadow caster to another. Once obtained the user can travel through shadows at the speed of light. They can also fire blasts of the dark energy in the forms of black/gray fire,lightening bolts,or raw energy.(Raw energy may back fire and cause serious damage to the user.) The user can also summon Shadow weapons.
summary: The ability to control and manipulate shadow energy
strengths: Great for Escapes
Power not limited to day or night
Shadow Energy is almost unstoppable
weaknesses: A back fire may kill the user
Hard to control where you'll end up when using shadow travel
Power may start to take control of the user

name: Infinity Sneakers
description: The infinity sneakers are a pair of shoes that allows you to move with greater super speed & defy gravity, this can include walking on walls, flying, floating, and being able to move with blinding speeds appearing as a blur. I can also you of impending danger.
summary: The ability to use them with great speed and defy gravity.
strengths: You are immune to earthquakes while wearing them.
Move faster than a speed of light & sound.
weaknesses: Could trip on evil-made obstacles.
Only immune to the shaking of the earth, not to the destruction and parting of the earth
Can be stolen

name: Reaper's Scythe
description: If you want someone dead, then all you have to do is slice. You can also use your scythe to slice into midair, and open a rift to anywhere in the world.
summary: The ability to use a scythe as a supernatural tool for killing and travel
strengths: You can be at home and kill someone anywhere in the world.
You can go on a vacation without having to pay.
weaknesses: You need a scythe.
You need to know where you want to go before you slice.

name: Time Manipulation Knowledge
description: You know how manipulating time works. This includes, but is not limited to, speeding up time, slowing it down, rewinding it, traveling through it, seeing the future, the past, jumping to other timelines, etc. You have a complete knowledge of how to build things to do this, and what materials you'll need/when they're available. Finally, if someone has an innate ability to interact with time, you will know how to awaken it, control it, how to train them, and how to disable them.
summary: The ability to know how to build time machines
strengths: A plethora of time powers are available to you
You can also make them availble to others, and look like a genius while you do it
Comes with an understanding of temporal mechanics- helps you with paradoxes
weaknesses: Of course, someone can steal the machines
Or analyze them
Or beat you with a pipe wrench until you explain it

name: Puppet Mastery
description: Controlling other people is something we all like to do, whether we want to admit it or not. A person with Puppet Mastery can manipulate the movements of other people as they please-- making them jump, run, dance, freeze in place or even hurt and kill themselves is only a gesture away.
summary: The ability to control other people's motor functions
strengths: Controlling others
Stopping small groups of assailants
Saying, "Stop hitting yourself!" over and over again
weaknesses: Not something you can use covertly
Larger groups require more mental strength
Can become vengeful and wrathful

name: Power Of Hard Work
description: Anyone with this power has the ability to gain simple abilities that can transcend peak human potential naturally through hard work. For example, through training, you can gain the ability to shatter mountains and run on water or jump on air. You can even gain superpowered intelligence by studying hard. There is no limit to how much you can train your acquired power, though it gets increasingly harder. Also, if you have existing superpowers, you can train them faster when you have this power.
summary: The ability to gain superpowers naturally through training and improve training speed
strengths: You can gain superpowers naturally
You learn faster depending on the amount of effort you put in
Normalization fluid does not negate acquired superpowers since they were your own training
weaknesses: You have to gain superpowers through your own hard work, sweat, and tears
If you are lazy, then this ability is pointless

name: Surface Grinding
description: This ability allows you to grind, or generally slide on any surface. Think of it as riding a skateboard without the skateboard. Any solid surface can be used to ride. Your body basically propels sideways in a skating position. Your feet will automatically follow the surface until it ends or you jump off. You can also follow any distinct line, such as a road lane. So if you use a spray paint can to create your own path, the speed is determined by the length; the longer you go, the faster you get.
summary: The ability to grind, or generally "ride", on any surface at extreme speeds
strengths: It is a cool way to travel and can make for some cool trick grinds
You can get up to 100-200 mph while grinding and stopping can be instant
You can also grind as an attack, either by using the momentum to attack or by "hand grinding" them
weaknesses: You can't grind on water or air
Very durable shoes, one with metal bottoms, are needed to withstand the friction caused by grinding
Surface grinding at extreme speeds can cause damage to the surface

name: 0 G: Zero Gravity Reduction
description: This ability can be used for many things. It obviously allows the user to reduce gravity, however, it is not only use to levitate oneself. You are also capable of making others float, and objects. However, at the higher bands, you can reduce the gravity within structures to the point that bonds are loosened and they are effectively vaporized
summary: The ability to reduce gravity to zero for various effects
strengths: Float/"fly"/levitate, and reduction in gravity helps in jumping and agility
Levitate other things
Reduce gravitational attraction to the point people fly away or objects are vaporized
weaknesses: Can't control your levitation path until you develop your ability
Can't control object's levitation path until you develop your ability
Can't vaporize objects until you develop your ability

name: Gliding
description: You could be able to harness the power of flight with minimal effort and minimal resistance
summary: The ability to fly smoothly and continuously along with minimal effort or resistance
strengths: It is practicly effortless (you don't need to flap your arms or anything)
No machinery is needed
You can go as far as you want to
weaknesses: You will need a running start
This ability takes time to fully master
People will be able to see you from the ground or otherwise

name: Dragon Morph
description: When you morph into a dragon, you possess every characteristic of the mythological creature. You can fly at super speeds, breathe fire, super sight and hearing, and the super strength of a dragon. You just have to concentrate in order to morph into the dragon creature.
summary: The ability to morph into a dragon creature.
strengths: Possess many separate abilities at once.
Ability to breathe fire, fly, strength, super senses.
weaknesses: Can only use dragon powers in dragon form.
Can not stay in dragon form forever.

name: Delete This Shadow Flight
description: It'll be a lot cooler if you were like Johnny Cage from Mortal Kombat, but not only not like he does his famous Shadow Kick you would fly into the skies leaving a black or green trail behind you.
summary: The ability to fly across the air anywhere at a steady speed, you would move faster, and leave a black trail.
strengths: No one will be able to catch you.
weaknesses: Same as a regular flying power

name: Velocity Displacement
description: The user is able to transfer and/or manipulate the speed and direction of any moving object. This ability has two specific targets, the initial object and the target object. The initial object must be moving for this ability to take effect, whereas the target may or may not be moving. The magnitude of this ability lies solely upon the initial objects velocity. The user can change the direction, but not how fast. This also negates the target's previous velocity, allowing complete control.
summary: The ability to transfer the speed and direction of one object to another object
strengths: Can move with unbeliveable speed
Can force objects to be repelled, shifted, or become stationary at a moment's notice
The user can combine multiple velocities into a single velocity
weaknesses: The initial object MUST be moving
Cannot change the speed, only its direction and the object it affects
Stopping a jet in mid-flight isn't the best idea

name: Fractal Shard Burst
description: With this power, besides the initial cutting damage, any shards that pierce flesh will grow inward into the flesh of an opponent as daggers. These daggers shatter if touched or moved or if the victim moves around causing each shard to grow into a new dagger. The only way to safely remove a dagger is by teleporting it from the victim or targeting the dagger with a pinpoint attack that will destroy it in one piece. This power has an effective range of 300 ft. You are immune to this power.
summary: The ability to shoot a burst of fractal crystalline shards from your hand.
strengths: Effectively paralyse a foe you hit with this attack.
One dagger can grow into 50 or 60 daggers.
Regeneration may work in a way to cause daggers to grow in an opponent.
weaknesses: Regeneration might work to eject a dagger from an opponent.
Opponents immune to an attack of this nature.

name: Cyber World Traveller
description:
This ability you can travel inside the internet via a computer terminal with internet connection. Instead of viewing a monitor screen; when accessing the world wide web. 
You can literally visit those web pages. Online video games only seem more real (just don't run out of lives). 
The rules of the cyber world apply to you too. 
With this power you can leave from any terminal that has internet access. So in theory can be used to teleport.
summary: The ability to travel into the cybernetic, internet world.
strengths: Have access to every website in the world.
Has teleportation potential. (Like into top secret military bases, area 51).
Obtain valueable bank account detail from everyone across the globe.
weaknesses: Cyber world rules apply to you.
Can only go into the cyber world via a computer terminal with internet access.
Security programs may find you as a threatining computer virus.

name: Sliders
description: With a special remote control you can go to other worlds that are based on your world's time just not actually yours.
summary: The ability to open portals to other dimensions
strengths: See new/other places on other worlds
weaknesses: If you change the time limit you could be lost in other dimensions

name: Alternate Temporal Bridging
description: This power is a complex and dangerous one. It gives the user the power to connect the different timelines for storage, travel, etc. When the user creates a connection, it forms a link between the two timelines with portals at the ends. Going into one of these portals will take you to the other timeline. However, you have no control about what comes through the portal (it could be a very dangerous other timeline). At the more advanced levels, you can connect many timelines at once.
summary: The ability to create connections between this timeline and others.
strengths: Connect timelines together for a variety of uses.
You could gain advanced technology from a timeline ahead of ours.
You can send enemies to a dangerous timeline.
weaknesses: You have no way of knowing what is in an alternate timeline.
Things can come through the timelines at the other side.
Only at ADVANCED levels can you connect multiple timelines at once.

name: Zonifying
description: Teacher: Blah blah blah blar blah blah. Lily:(zoned out). Teacher: Lily, when did Marco Polo travel to China from Italy? Lily: Why, 1217, ofcourse (smiles sweetly). Teacher: (scowls)
summary: The ability to zone out in class, but somehow remember all of the important points
strengths: Help with school!
You will become smart
weaknesses: You're bored.

name: Ability Countermeasures
description: If a person with Ability Countermeasures were facing a Pyrokinetic, they would develop Cryokinesis. If they squared off against a Speedster, they would be able to Slow Time. Ability Countermeasures is the ultimate nemesis: it finds a way to nullify any ability's advantage.
summary: The ability to produce a superpower for every superpowered problem
strengths: Become the weapon of last resort
The more powerful they are, the more powerful you are
Could potentially beat down the Hulk
weaknesses: Only lasts as long as the threat lasts
If faced with many powered foes, get the ability to Teleport
Only works with powered foes

name: Cartoon Physics (Toon Physics)
description: We've all seen cartoons defy human physics for the sake of comedy. Well, imagine if you had the same powers. To defy gravity until you notice so. To access hammerspace (to produce objects from seemingly out of nowhere). To slow one's fall for a safe landing. To travel into drawings, cartoons, TV, movies and cyberspace at will. To pick up and use holes like tangible objects. And most important, the user can't die, since that isn't funny. Though, he can still feel pain, only not that much.
summary: The ability to adhere to absurdly more lenient laws of physics
strengths: Be a human cartoon by defying the laws of human physics
Inability to die, aging and injury are impermanent, and feel less pain than normal
Sense of humor automatically improves
weaknesses: Can only be used in comedic situations (until developed)
Still feel pain
You'll be the laughing stock of the superhero community

name: Holey Man
description: With this power, you can create holes that lead nowhere, or portals that can lead to wherever you want.
summary: The ability to create tactile holes and portals.
strengths: It's very easy to kill a person with this power.
Your portals can lead anywhere you want.
weaknesses: It's very draining to create a long-distance portal.
You need a very clear mental image of the place your portal leads.
Don't send two people in at a time, a 'la The Fly.

name: Randomize Door
description: This power allows the user to, upon opening a door, randomize the out location to any other door in the universe. For example, you could open your front door and come out of the closet of a French mansion. The output location is random and the connection between door A and door B only exists for as long as the door is open, becoming normal once the door is closed. If one is displeased by whats on the other side of the door, one need only close it and reopen it to try for somewhere else.
summary: The ability to randomize the output location of any door.
strengths: Make a quick escape to anywhere, from anywhere.
Create a stable portal to some place amazing by keeping the door open.
weaknesses: It's random where it puts you out.
It only works on doors.
Things can get strange when it connects two doors of different sizes.

name: Book Nitro
description: This power allows you to go into the world of a book. You could end up changing the whole story line and if someone reads it, YOU will be in the book. There are no loop holes. You can't get stuck. BUT you can die or be discovered. You can take as many people as you want with you and bring people back with you.
summary: The ability to Transport yourself into a book
strengths: You can be IN a book.
You can become a main character
You can bring the characters back if you persuade them.
weaknesses: You might ruin the whole plot.
You could die.
You could be discovered.

name: Juggernaut
description: To use your power, you have to run. Once in a speeding motion, you build up a kinetic energy force. the force of a charging rhino, bulldozer, train, & wrecking ball combined. You'll have that increased strength & speed. A force to be reckoned with. Demolishing almost anything & everything in your path. Though it is hard to stop, almost exhausting.
summary: The ability to become an almost unstoppable force when running
strengths: Increased strength & speed
Demolish anything in your path
weaknesses: Hard to stop

name: Broken Teleportation
description: With this power you can teleport to anything or anybody as lone as you have a piece of it/them in your hand. For example if you were to break a pencil and carry half of it around with you and leave the over half of it at your house, you could teleport back home whenever you wanted. Or if you manage to get a part of an enemy (a piece of hair, a hand, a nail etc. ) then you would be able to teleport to his/her location and capture them.
summary: The ability to teleport to something if you're holding a piece of it
strengths: You can teleport to anything as long as you have a piece of it in your hands
weaknesses: You have to be holding a piece of something for this power to work

name: Time Skip
description: A person with this power can erase a time frame in the immediate future. During this time frame only the user knows what is going on. Such as skipping a barrage of bullets, the bullets hit the wall and the user is unharmed, because the instance where they were hit was erased. If the user is skilled in control they can also skip ahead to move, such as skipping driving. (You still drove but the time where you drove is isolated from the rest of time)Luckily, the user can still see what they skipped
summary: The ability to erase a time frame in the immediate future
strengths: Dodge attacks(Skip them)
Skip past places(similar to teleporting except it takes time and energy
You can see what would have happened if you didn't skip time
weaknesses: Another Pro: Only you notice that time was skipped. Other people just think something else happened
Can't go back in time
You still age-even more if you continuously use this power

name: Tick Tock
description: With this power, you can go back and forth through time by moving the hands on a clock. For example, if you move the hands to 1:00, it will be 1:00. You can't, however, change what has already happened, or bring a living thing, excluding you, through time.
summary: The ability to control time by moving a clock's hands
strengths: You can look what your opponent will do.
You can check what will happen tommorrow.
You can read test answers.
weaknesses: You can't change the past or future when using this power.
You can't bring anybody with you.
You can't use a clock that doesn't have hands.

name: Phantom Beast Mimicry
description: I don't know much about phantom beasts. My guess was that they are ghost-like animals. This ability is an evolutionary ability. First, it seems that you have the ability to phase through solid objects, but then it changes. You will start having powers that are both feral and ghostly. Each person will gain different powers. This ability can give you clues on what animal is your true favorite. Your senses and physical attributes increase as well.
summary: The ability to possess the mysterious properties of a phantom beast.
strengths: Gain mysterious powers.
Increase senses and physical attributes.
weaknesses: Each person will gain different abilities.

name: Maneuvering Through Air
description: While the person with this ability cannot fly, they jump and maneuver through air so well that it doesn't really matter. The user has an adept sense over air patterns such that they can make the right movements to give themselves the best hangtime and application of force through air. As such, the user is an adept combatant when given a decent amount of room. Also, the user can scale buildings by jumping and rebounding off walls. When mastered, the user can even change their trajectory at will.
summary: The ability to jump really high and maneuver in the air so well that it looks like you are flying
strengths: Make up totally ridiculous attacks that are at the limit of human ability
Scale buildings by jumping/rebounding
You can change your trajectory while in the air
weaknesses: You can't really fly(not really a con)
Looks somewhat girly to do the flips and stuff required to move through the air
Needs to have a decent physical body

name: Lightning God
description: A blinding speed that makes you the master of gravitational space. You can see nano light particles, hyper movement and sound vibrations in slow motion.
summary: The ability to travel and move as fast as a speed of light.
strengths: Multi-task.
Excellent offensive and defensive measure.
weaknesses: For each use, you loose 1 minute of your lifespan.

name: Was Scepter
description: The Was Scepter bestows upon the user immortality, godly strength, speed, and experience with magic. The scepter can also raise the dead and create portals to the underworld (netherworld).
summary: The ability to acquire an Egyptian scepter and utilize its mystical properties.
strengths: Immortal.
Revive those who have fallen.
The scepter is attuned to the user, so it is accessible by mind.
weaknesses: Raising decayed individuals would frighten people.
The underworld is dangerous.

name: Time Cut
description: With this ability, you are able to go to the future and the past.
summary: The ability to cut up portals in time.
strengths: Go to any time period
Meet famous people in History
weaknesses: Messing up with time is dangerous

name: Omni Substitution
description: The user can act as a substitute for anything another person needs him to be, a power source, transportation, e food or a person of a certain profession. At first, this ability only activates when the need for a substitution is issued. The user can master it so that they do not need another person to issue the need for substitution.
summary: The ability to become a substitute of anything.
strengths: Become a substitute for anything else.
Have all the abilities of the thing you are substituting for.
weaknesses: Without training, the ability does not activate until substitution is needed.
The abilities of the thing you are substituting for are temporary.

name: Dimensional Teleportation
description: You can go straight to where you would be in the exact same spot in another dimensions.
summary: The ability to teleport to other Dimensions
strengths: You can go to a different dimension before you are killed
You can get tons of friends all over the dimensions
You might end in a girls' locker room
weaknesses: You might go into space
You need to wait 1 hour until you can go to another dimension
Something bad happens to what dimension you leave

name: Accelerated Test Taking
description: With this power you can take any test, quiz or questioner at an accelerated pace. You still get all the answers you would've gotten had you took more time to think about the questions and then go over your work. It take you about three and a half seconds to complete each multiple choice question. Ten seconds for short answer and about a minute to do essay questions.
summary: The ability to take tests or quizes at an advanced speed
strengths: You can take tests at an accelerated pace
You get the same answers
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
It still take some time just not as much

name: Master Of Inventions
description: The user is able to invent something that is unique that can be either used for offensive or defensive purposes. This power also covers the planning phase. The user cannot build inventions of other people at a 100%
summary: The ability to invent something unique
strengths: Good at inventing gadgets
Unique inventions, only you can use it or only allies
weaknesses: Can't reverse engineer enemy gadgets perfectly

name: Darksiders: Serpent Road
description: The Serpent Road is a sub-space where you must walk along a stone path in an empty void. Just pick the location you wish to travel to, and you will be taken into the Serpent Road. Once you make it to the portal at the end of the road, you will be at your destination.
summary: The ability to travel miles within seconds.
strengths: Travel from Seattle to New York City in one minute!
Never have to pay for plane tickets ever
weaknesses: This is not teleportation; you still have to do some form of travel

name: Mental Route Navigation
description: This power allows an individual to instantly find a path to or from any point instantly, either between that point and their current location or between two other locations. This factors in not only mundane routes such as driving or walking, but also factors in things like public transportation and allows for the supernatural, such as finding a path to a different time or reality. It even factors in side benefits, such as support of local business or exercise.
summary: The ability to think of a location and find a suitable path to that point.
strengths: Factors in cost (monetary and otherwise) as well as timetables.
You can find any possible route, unless actively hidden, almost certainly through non-mundane means.
You immediately know of a short list of the best options, rather than having to do it manually.
weaknesses: Almost entirely useless if you have other travel-related powers, such as teleportation.
Only useful for travel; no point if you are not travelling or are satisfied with your current route.
Does not warn you of most dangers along the route.

name: Teleport To Friend(S)
description: With this power you can teleport straight to wherever your friend(s) are/is whether it is 100 yards away or on the other side of the universe.
summary: The ability to teleport to where one's friend(s) are/is located at
strengths: You can help your friends whenever they need help.
weaknesses: You are unable to teleport back home.
You cannot teleport to other dimensions until the higher levels.
If you only have imaginary friends then this power is useless.

name: Jail Immunity
description: With this power you will never be sent to jail for any crime from loitering to murder. You won't even be taken to court or be put on trial. Additionally you cannot get a speeding or parking ticket and are more or less immune to the laws of any country.
summary: The ability to never go to jail for a crime
strengths: You will never be arrested, take to court, put on trial or receive parking tickets, speeding tickets
Or fines
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Safety Net
description: This power acts as an automatic safety net for when you're about to die or be killed. Right before the moment of death, you'll be transported to a random, immediately safe location. It could be a little as 5 feet away, or as far as the other side of the world. You can't activate this power and you can't choose where to be transported to. But on the up side, it happens automatically, even if you don't realize you're about to die. It takes about an hour before you can use this power again.
summary: The ability to teleport to a random, safe location right before being killed
strengths: Chances of being accidentally killed are greatly reduced
You won't need to wear your seatbelt anymore
Skydiving without the parachute!
weaknesses: You can be transported to ANYWHERE, like Africa or even to a ship at sea
Explaining to the cop WHY you don't need your seatbelt
You might only transport to a few feet away

name: Spatial Awareness
description: Worried about ending up in a wall? With this power, you will sense whether your target includes physical matter and will guide to a position in which you are free from being trapped in matter. This even extends to others teleporting you. Thanks to WHD for suggesting this.
summary: The ability to sense the presence of matter at a target for teleportation.
strengths: Never teleport into a wall.
Passive.
Includes matter carried with you.
weaknesses: Useless without teleportation.
Still vulnerable to all other danger.
Teleportation poses other risks (i. E. Teleporting into the vacuum of space).

name: Cocoon Flight
description: This power gives you the ability to fly very fast. The more air resistance you build up the stronger the cocoon gets. The cocoon is big enough for you to be able to fly in whatever position you'd like.   The ability to simply fly would be worthless you want to fly faster than 200mph since the wind resistance would rip your clothes apart and you would go deaf from all the air passing by your ears. A cocoon solves that problem.
summary: The ability to fly extremely fast, without the wind holding you back.
strengths: The ability to fly, safe and secure against wind resistance, in a cocoon of air.
You can travel wherever you want
The cocoon is always strong enough as long as you don't hit any big or heavy objects.
weaknesses: You are not invisible. People can spot you flying.
You are not invincible. You can still crash into something and die.
Don't fly in to space; there is no resistance out there and the cocoon would go away.

name: Wayne Enterprises
description: With this power you are able to get products directly made from any Wayne Enterprise section. You will receive free shipping from your products. This company excels in stealth, hand-to-hand combat, and aero-transportation.
summary: The ability to get products from Wayne Enterprises.
strengths: You get excellent products for free.
weaknesses: It is bad in certain areas compared to Lexcorp/Stark Industries.

name: Matter Redirection
description: If you place your hand near something and concentrate, you can dispel it through your other hand or your feet. This is easier to do with objects smaller than your palm or your sole, any larger items take more concentration and may come out completely shredded. You can shoot matter at your enemy, and redirect projectiles to a degree. You can absorb dirt through your feet and dispel it through your hands, allowing for easy underground travel, a process that also can be applied for limited flight.
summary: The ability to absorb matter through one limb and dispel it from another
strengths: Really Versatile
Underground travel and flight, kinda
Become a wood chipper!
weaknesses: Cannot store matter
Fast projectiles need a mostly straight line between the limbs, so redirecting bullets is dangerous
Difficult to redirect large solids

name: Stardust Transformation
description: The user is able to transform his or her form into stardust. The stardust form is purely for transportation and distraction purposes only. The stardust hole does not have any offensive abilities
summary: The ability to transform yourself into stardust
strengths: Can distract enemies
Can fly around
weaknesses: Cannot attack enemies

name: Gravity Switch
description: With this power you can turn gravity upside down but only for you. You can walk up walls as if it's a flat, normal plane. There must be something above you, for example, a lightbulb.
summary: The ability to this power allows you to see everything and work as if the gravity has changed.
strengths: Fantastic for hiding and stealth.
Easily escape from things.
weaknesses: There must be something above you.
Dizzy-ness :P

name: Moon Angel
description: A moon angel abilities are to fly,hydrokinesis and calmness inducement. In the night they are able heal as well but in the day a moon angel is only capable of using one power which the moon angel can decide on what it is.
summary: The ability to become a moon angel
strengths: Can fly and know how to fly
Control water which can be fun
Can be seen as a normal angel and be worshipped
weaknesses: You might not like being worshipped
When it's day time so you're a lot weaker
Your enemies sun angels could take advantage of the daylight

name: Cyclonic Past
description: Through what you might call a cyclone, you go into a chosen part in your past and can contact your earlier self to change the path you walked on.
summary: The ability to travel into your own past and change what you do by contacting yourself
strengths: May avoid death
May choose the better side of life
weaknesses: Can alter the timeline greatly
Can cause death
May become stuck in the past and destroy it

name: Leprechaun Teleport
description: Leprechauns are magical creatures. They have many abilities, and one of them is teleporting. But they can only teleport when no one is watching. You now can do the same. As long as no one is looking when you leave or when you arrive, you can teleport anywhere on the planet.
summary: The ability to teleport, as long as no one's looking.
strengths: Poping up behind someone.
Great magic trick
weaknesses: Very strange power

name: Super Shoes
description: With this power you get super shoes. Super shoes are magical shoes that allow the user to jump higher and run fast than the average person but not as fast or high as a person with super speed or super jumping powers. They also make it hurt a lot when you kick someone or step on them. The shoes can also become any style of any kind of shoe you want (they start off as nondescript brown shoes) they also grow when your foot grows so they always fit. As soon as you take them off they disappear.
summary: The ability to have super shoes
strengths: You have super shoes
When you take them off they disappear until you want them again so nobody can steal them
They do all the things described above
weaknesses: When you're not wearing the shoes you don't have the abilities they give you

name: Nightmare Dimension
description: All of humanity's nightmares go to one place: the nightmare dimension. Your power allows you to transport anyone to and from this place. All the fear and terror possibly dreamed lives here and is made into phyisical forms to inflict horror, terror, fear and harm to any visitors. This dark realm has no escape unless you wish it.
summary: The ability to teleport people to a dimension of all of humanity's darkest nightmares
strengths: Cause victims terror
Be a living Freddy Krueger
weaknesses: ...if sending people to a terrible dimesion and causing insanity is wrong, I don't wanna be right
Can only stay inside dimension for 24 hours, then the target is teleported back to our dimension

name: Homing Propulsion
description: This power enables you to give any object, that you are throwing, the property to aim at any target you want and to move towards it. Unless an external force acts upon the object, the latter remains at the same speed it was thrown at. The target must be in your line of sight when you throw your object, but once the target is locked on, the object will keep homing in on it until either one of them is destroyed, the object is stopped or you decide to cancel your action.
summary: The ability to throw any object which will home in on any target
strengths: You don't need to guide your object yourself. It will aim on its own.
Increase your chances of hitting your target. You will rarely miss.
Keep track of your target's movements.
weaknesses: The more inertia the object has, the less maneuverable it is.
Can be avoided if the target is faster or more maneuverable.

name: Energy Teleportation
description: The user will be able to teleport any energy from one point to another. Able to teleport their energy attack directly at the target without them knowing. The can teleport the energy they or others have like kinetic, heat, bio, etc. Even energy beings can be teleported away from or at the the user.
summary: The ability to teleport energy to different location.
strengths: Make instant energy attacks
Safety from energy attacks.
Get more energy for yourself.
weaknesses: Beware of taking your own energy away.

name: Virus Mimicry
description: A Virus Mimic can reprogram someone else's power to create something, giving them the power to create an identical copy of the Virus Mimic themselves. Their new power is also reprogrammed to always be active, forcing them to create a copy whenever possible. Materialization powers are any power that allows the user to create something physical by bypassing laws of conservation. They don't include summoning powers, as they involve calling/teleporting already-existing things.
summary: The ability to hi-jack materialization powers to duplicate yourself.
strengths: Duplicate yourself by using other people's power to create something.
Duplication and self-duplication powers are included in the materialization powers.
Some transformation powers are included if they imply creation of new material to increase the mass.
weaknesses: This power is NOT a duplication power as the user doesn't create anything with it.
Transformation powers that respect the laws of conservation cannot be reprogrammed.
Powers that only create mental objects or intangible energy (light, heat, force) are immune to it.

name: Techno Teleport
description: When you are a "Technoport", you will be able to instantly teleport between electronics. Anything that is considered technology, you can teleport to. And anything you hold with you can also be brought through the teleporting process. But you can only teleport to a technology in a 1 mile radius.
summary: The ability to transport yourself through electronics
strengths: Fighting someone in an electronics store
Be the best shoplifter
weaknesses: Only a 1 mile radius
No technology, no teleport

name: 7 Swords
description: The person with this power is able to summon 7 different swords that each has a special property. The first sword is the fire sword , the second sword is the lightning sword, the third sword is the adamant sword, the fourth sword is the sword of invisibility, the fifth sword is the sword of speed, the six sword a sword that can change its length and finally the seventh sword is a sword that can open portals.
summary: The ability to summon seven swords, that each has its own unique power
strengths: Different swords to combat different situations
Swords are mystical and cannot be destroyed by conventional means
weaknesses: Some swords are still made up of metal and although mystical, magnetism users can still disarm them
The user of the swords have to train for years to master them

name: Speed Reading (Speedreading)
description: One with this ability has a sort of superspeed ability that is limited to one's reading and comprehension of words on a page. In essence, the user can read written or typed material at an incredibly fast pace, and retain the entirety of the information for as long as he would remember information read at a NORMAL pace. The user could read an entire manual within seconds, and a whole book in mere minutes.
summary: The ability to read at superhuman speeds
strengths: No more wasted hours reading boring books and manuals; still boring, just take less time
Word searches are a breeze
The enhanced reading speed may result in enhancement of one's VISION in general
weaknesses: Doesn't NECESSARILY result in (or result from) superhuman sight
Doesn't help your comprehension of words you don't know
Doesn't make reading any more interesting, aside from getting done with it faster

name: Stunt Double
description: It's like Hugh Jackman's character in The Prestige. The machine replicated him, and as one drowned the other was teleported at a safe distance. That's this power; whenever in deadly harm's way, you automatically make & teleport a duplicate to a safe area. But the original must die. Once dead, they vanish into atoms & their engery transfers into the duplicate. Also, you still age normally & are subject to illness.
summary: The ability to replicate yourself when in inevitable death's way
strengths: Auto make a duplicate of yourself when in peril
Duplicate will be exactly like you with all memories up to point of death of original
Any illness or injuries that inflict the original will not transfer to copy. A new, healthy you.
weaknesses: Original must die. After death, they vanish.
Still age normally, so when down to old age, natural cause will most likely make you vanish.

name: Lifeforce Drain
description: We speak of someone like, "Oh, he/she just sucks the life out of me." It's not a joke anymore. A Lifeforce Drainer can absorb the vitality of a person just by touching them. This prolongs their lifespan, but kills the person. As if this were not enough, they also absorb the person's special ability (Flight, Superhuman Speed, etc.).
summary: The ability to suck the ability and life out of a person
strengths: Potentially live forever
Get some amazing superhuman powers
Kill swiftly and silently
weaknesses: Kills the target
Must touch to drain
May lead to people organizing to take you down

name: Tele Clone
description: When the user activates his teleporting abilities there will be a puff of smoke and it looks like they haven't left yet. However, the person that is left behind is actually a clone of the original. The clone is in all ways the same as the original and can only be told apart by superhuman intuition or omniscience. The clones can learn and can become independent after they recover from their creation. Killing the user does not kill the clones and vice versa. There can only be 99 clones at a time.
summary: The ability to teleport while leaving a clone behind
strengths: Fake your death then plan for another ambush
Teleport many times in the same location to create a 100 strong army
The clones are undistinguishable by the common supersenses
weaknesses: The clones all have the same condition as you so they will not be healed
You must kill the clones after you are done using them
This power does not come with the ability to telepathically talk to your clones

name: Animalism
description: This ability lets you create/be like any animal you want. Imagine you are a winged human, flying through the sky as high as you want, being a human with gills, and maybe even half human half wolf like a werewolf. This power is SICK!!!
summary: The ability to create limbs similar to animals on yourself
strengths: Breath under water
Fly
Be animal like
weaknesses: It
Is
Sick

name: Ability Granting
description: Many theorize that everyone has ability potential. A person with Ability Granting can unlock that with a touch. The process grants a totally random ability-anything from Hydrokinesis to Intuitive Aptitude to Flight. It lasts for a week.
summary: The ability to temporarily imbue people with superpowers
strengths: Create a super-powered army
Make friends/debtors fast
Make someone's day
weaknesses: Can unlock a dangerous and uncontrollable ability
Can have your army turn on you
Cannot use it on yourself

name: Chrono Bullet
description: The ability to shoot bullets from your fingertips. That effect can be activated by saying the time + the keyword. Another way to use the chrono bullets is to shoot them into a solid thing (except a human). That thing will become a portal towards said time.
summary: The ability to shoot bullets and open portals from the present to the past.
strengths: For offense
For time travel
weaknesses: To kill someone

name: Farwalking
description: Ever hear of 7 League Boots? With Farwalking, you don't need them. Using this power, you can cover miles with a single step. The distance covered is controlled by the size of the step. With your longest stride, you could step halfway around the world. And if you want to walk normally, you can just turn the power off.
summary: The ability to cover long distances with a single step
strengths: No need for cars, planes, etc.
You'd be unbeatable in races
weaknesses: Can only go in a straight line
It's hard to control the distance covered

name: Color Shirt Power
description: With this power you have a different power depending on the color of the shirt you're wearing. Red: Heat Vision. Blue: Ice Manipulation. Green: Plant Manipulation. Black: Shadow Manipulation. Orange: Super Speed. Yellow: Heat Resistance. White: Invisibility. Gray: Rise of the Demon. Pink: Force Fields. Tan: Flight. Purple: Super Strength. Brown: Elasticity. The list includes any shade of the color in question. If the shirt you're wearing has more than one color, you get more than one power.
summary: The ability to have a different power depending on the color(s) of your shirt
strengths: You can get some pretty awesome powers
weaknesses: If you're not wearing a shirt you have no powers
The color of your pants have no effect on your powers

name: Free Fall
description: With Free Fall, one can slow down at the apex of a jump, even to the point where one "hovers" in mid-air.  One can accelerate your fall while grappling a foe in mid-air to do some serious damage with a suplex.  Increase the lateral distance that can be travelled with a single bound, or twist and maneuver around in mid-air to perform all sorts of stunts before hitting the ground.  A bonus of having this power is having a resistance to low-pressure atmospheres... as long as it's there.
summary: The ability to completely control one's descent to the ground, as long as you eventually get there.
strengths: Just about unmatched aerial maneuverability.
Never worry about a hard landing, even if dropped from a plane.
Let's face it: this'd be bad-ass if you were into X-treme Sports or freerunning.
weaknesses: If you don't really have a means of getting to a good height, the applications are limited.
There's almost no offensive firepower, so it'd only be good for dodging in combat.
There's only so many people that you can "carry" with this power...

name: Blessing Of Tychon
description: Tychon is the Greek god of Luck and Chance. His blessing grants powers in both. For Luck, the user is endowed with uncanny good luck. They also can endow people and objects with good or bad luck. As for Chance, they gain the ability to manipulate it. For example, if they were on the run, they could encourage the chance of someone giving them a ride.
summary: The ability to have the Blessing of Tychon
strengths: Good luck for you and your friends
Bad luck for your enemies
Influencing probability in your favor. Always having shelter, food, weapons, money, etc.
weaknesses: Too much luck can take the fun out of things
Influencing events in a bad way. Ex) Car that was supposed to hit a bank robber, instead hits a cop.

name: Myth Power: Prowess Of Proioxis
description: Proioxis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of pursuit and giving chase. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive the location, number and identity of any target one pursues, and hunt them with predatory instinct. In addition, one may surpass the speed of any target one pursues. At the higher levels, one may even cause one's target to slow down, as well as communicate with, and transform into, any animal considered a predatory animal.
summary: The ability to channel Proioxis' command over the essence of pursuit and onrush
strengths: Perceive the location, identity and number of pursued targets
Gain predatory instinct (even when the power is otherwise not in use)
Slow down targets and transform into a predatory animal at the higher bands
weaknesses: Some predatory animals are also considered predators (may get confusing)
Cannot COMPEL predatory animals until the higher bands
People with MythPower: Teumessian Fox-Trot are immune to this ability

name: Matter Dissolution
description: Matter Dissolution is a more dangerous version of Phasing. The user passes through solid objects, just like a Phaser. But as soon as they have gone through it, it breaks down and crumbles. This is because they break down binding forces as they pass through it. So, while they can walk through walls, they leave a big gaping hole afterwards.
summary: The ability to pass through solid matter, crumbling it afterwards
strengths: Can walk through walls
Break down what you have gone through
Very good for combat
weaknesses: Leave crumbling holes in the walls you have passed through
Must be careful what you pass through
Rather obvious

name: Teleport Then Explode
description: With this power you can teleport and then cause the place you were standing to explode and wipe out everything in a ten mile radius. This is useful if you're standing next to an enemy you can simply teleport more than ten miles away and cause the place you were standing to explode to wipe out your enemy.
summary: The ability to teleport then cause the place that you used to be standing to explode
strengths: You can teleport
You can turn the explosions on and off
weaknesses: If the explosions are on you have to teleport at least ten miles away from where you were standing

name: Magician's Touch
description: Some people have a gift called the Magicain's Touch. Locks will open at your touch, guns will never run out of bullets, and broken-down cars will run again with a brush of your hands. Your can even use your touch to persuade people and tame animals.
summary: The ability to possess the Magicain's Touch
strengths: Very useful power.
You can persuade people.
weaknesses: Not much use in a fight.

name: Liquid Teleportation
description: You can teleport nearby bodies of liquid, up to the size of an swimming pool, to other locations that you can see. You have to point an index finger at the liquid to teleport it. The liquid will be teleported out of its container, leaving the container behind empty
summary: The ability to teleport liquids around you
strengths: Teleport drinks out of cups or kegs into your glass
Teleporting the blood out of a foe. Bit messy, but it's quick
Get rid of puddles in your way
weaknesses: Can only teleport liquids

name: Solar Fueled Spaceflight
description: With this power, you can travel through space, provided you have enough sunlight. As you absorb the rays of the sun, you gain the ability to fly, resistance to the low pressure, radiation and temperature extremes and sustenance (including air) from the sun's rays.
summary: The ability to fly through space using solar energy.
strengths: Fly through space!
Fly high in the atmosphere.
Has plenty of everyday uses.
weaknesses: Space agencies will want to study you.
Space is huge -you would have an extremely hard time exploring it all.
You can't extend it to others without conscious effort.

name: The Never Ending Slide
description: You can create space-skipping portals of convenience, two at a time, that are linked to each other. These may appear on, in, or overlapping objects. If you create a third portal, the second is now linked to that one and the first is destroyed, and so on. One fun example of using this would be to put a portal near the top of a large slide and another near the bottm, so the slide appears to go on forever. Or you could just make it easier to grab a pie from the fridge.
summary: The ability to create portals linked to one another
strengths: Convenient travel
The lazy man's dream, no need to get up, just reach into the fridge from where you sit
If someone annoys you, push them into a portal beneath another portal, making them fall forever
weaknesses: Limited to two linked portals
You have to have been somehwere first to place the portals before you can go there through them
Very obvious and hard to fit in with the decor

name: Ultimate Cowboy Quick Draw
description: A person with this power will always be the first to fire/use their weapon or activate their skill and abilities. A sure and instant fight or flight reaction is always an advantage. Imagine you're in a situation where you're up against someone with the power to: a. Kill you instantly; b. Nullify, manipulate or dampen all of your powers; c. Escape or instantly run away from you. This power will make sure that before they can even say their magic word you have already completed your desired act.
summary: The ability to always be the first person to fire/use a weapon or activate an ability.
strengths: Use your most powerful ability before it gets nullified, manipulated, or dampened.
This ability even works against passive abilities and their instant effects which are always active.
Everybody else (including their abilities) is ready for second place, even Superman!
weaknesses: Nothing! Even time manipulators are no match for you!

name: Velocity Match
description: Dependent object skips all intermediate speeds and directions, jumping instantly to the target's. As long as this power is sustained, other stimuli on dependent object are ignored, such as gravity, air resistance and obstacles. Power can be used to either increase or decrease something's speed as well as change its direction. If the power is turned off, the dependent object will lose momentum and be affected by everything normally. If the independent object is hurt, so will the dependent.
summary: The ability to make an object (or person) instantly go at the same speed and direction as another.
strengths: Best hitchhiker ever.
Can shoot someone like a bullet or throw them like a penny in a well.
Don't need to worry about falling long distances (just match velocity before you hit the ground).
weaknesses: Matching velocity with something right before it crashes.
Losing concentration at high speeds.
People may insist you sit outside the car when seats are limited.

name: Speedwings
description: You will be some bright color on your wrists and ankles, and with them you can go faster than a bullet. You can do ordinary running with them, jump, or fly, and they can slice as short range-weapons. However, unless you can speed up your mindtime then you will have a lot of trouble reacting. Also, if you stop too quickly you might break something.
summary: The ability to fly with brightly colored wings on your wrists and ankles
strengths: You go really fast
You can fly
Wings double as weapons
weaknesses: Until you get used to it, you might have trouble controlling it
Unless you can speed up your mindtime, then it'll be as confusing to you as it is to your opponent
Stopping suddenly will hurt because of backlash

name: Movie Teleportation
description: With this power you can teleport to any real location that appears in a movie that you are watching. You can stay in the place as long as you want but to get back you'd either have to walk/use a vehicle or watch a movie that takes place where you live. This power does not work with home movies or TV shows.
summary: The ability to teleport to any location that appears in a movie that you are watching
strengths: You can teleport to any real location that appears in a movie that you are watching
weaknesses: It is sometimes hard to get back
You have to be watching a movie for this power to work
The location has to be in the movie

name: Wings Of The Crow
description: It is the ability to summon black wings on your back so you can fly and do anything exactly like a bird using your wings.
summary: The ability to summon black wings on your back to help you fly
strengths: The ability to fly
Being able to get away from the crowd
You can get to places very quickly
weaknesses: You would have feather on your back and it would need cleaning
People might be afraid of you when they see you
Birds will follow you as their leader

name: Birth Right
description: Have control over your horoscope, horoscope animal, horoscope gems, etc. If you are Scorpio then you have power over scorpions, topaz, anger, you can turn into a giant scorpion, part morph, etc. Have power over your Zodiac symbols as well. If you were born in the year of the rabbit then you have power over rabbits, can morph into or partly into one, have incredible running an jumping powers, etc.
summary: The ability to have powers over your horoscope and Zodiac symbols
strengths: Cool abilities
Control over certain animals and gems
Control over certain feelings or things
weaknesses: Depends on when you were born

name: Hermes' Helmet
description: The person who posses Hermes' Helmet will be able to run very fast, approximately the speed of lightning. The helmet will stay on the user as long as he or she wills it. If the user is knocked out, the helmet has a small chance to get dislodged from their head. Another person can't use this helmet unless the current user gives it to the other person for them to use
summary: The ability to run fast whenever the user wears Hermes's Helmet
strengths: Can run really fast
Can deliver a barrage of fast punches
Can be the first on the scene of the crime.
weaknesses: Has a chance to get dislodged from the user's head if they are knocked out
Might phase out of the physical realm if they run to fast

name: Super Followthrough
description: A person with this power can create a super-localized time stop which also removes the touched object from current timeline to increased their follow through without decreasing their force allowing them to make big impacts without Newton's third law being in the way--ie you use a small force but you apply it over a long time making a big impact. Naturally this can be used to send things flying with huge momentum.
summary: The ability to increase the impact of any object you throw
strengths: All you need is to be good at throwing and everything becomes a deadly weapon
Newton's third law does not get in they way--your applied force is small
Effects are only active in real time so no one knows that time was stopped
weaknesses: No superstrength---its all about the time

name: Planar Repulsion
description: This power, also called plane connection elimination, is the power to repulse the different planes of reality. This allows the user to release merged planes as well as force anything on another plane away by repulsing the plane it dwells in. This provides protection against interplanar attack. The users very presence causes a large separation between planes which can disrupt any portal between planes as well as insulate against any action in other planes of reality.
summary: The ability to prevent the planes of reality from connecting.
strengths: Protection against extra-planear entities and inter-planear attack.
Can undo the mergings of the different planes.
Can prevent portals that connect the planes.
weaknesses: Reality bending.
Things that exist on many planes.
If an extra-planar entity is already on your plane.

name: Soul Marker
description: A person with this power has the ability to place part of their soul into a restore point. If the user dies he is instantly transported to his restore point-alive but dazed. The user can also teleport freely from restore points. If all restore points have been destroyed the user dies. Restore points are set by throwing a materialized knife at a location. Restore points can be moved by taking out the knife-doing so will cause the part of your soul to return.
summary: The ability to mark restore points where you can revive/teleport to
strengths: Teleportating to protect your restore points
Revival at restore points
You can also use the marker knives as weapons
weaknesses: Cannot prevent old age
If you split your soul too much(not a good thing)
If people destroy your soul markers

name: Living Portal
description: As living portal you can't move and you lose all senses. The only powers you have that keep working are passive non-physical ones. Omniscience on demand still works. Size manipulation and shapechanging powers will let you be a smaller,bigger or non-human shaped portal. 100% of your body exist in Limbo(the space between dimensions) when you're a living portal.
summary: The ability to turn into a human-shaped portal between two locations,times or dimensions.
strengths: A form of invulnerability.
If foes can't travel to Limbo to attack you physically.
weaknesses: A foe who can travel to Limbo.
Powers that negate or control time travel,teleportation or dimension travel.
Unless you have omniscience on demand you can't perceive anything.

name: Corrosion
description: Corrosion. It's why stuff doesn't last for millions of years. A person with Corrosion can speed up the process 10,000 times with a touch, making iron rust and collapse, wood rot in an instant, and plastic bags dissolve before your eyes.
summary: The ability to induce the breaking down of a material
strengths: Very useful
No real limits on the size of what can be affected
Destroy resources rapidly
weaknesses: No affect on already corroded materials
No affect on incorrodables, i.e gold, solid plastics, etc.
Limited affect on objects covered by patinas

name: Time Replacement
description: You can replace any event that has happened with a new one of your choosing. An example of this could be changing what you had for breakfast this morning. Rule of what you cannot do: you cannot remove someone from existence. You cannot undo your own death, but you can change non-fatal things. You cannot tamper with peoples lives directly. The new events that you used to replace the old ones will not change the past or the future in a significant way. THIS POWER DOES NOT LET YOU TRAVEL IN TIME.
summary: The ability to replace events that have happened with different ones.
strengths: You can do whatever you want to, then go back and change what you did.
You can relive certain events.
You can look forward or back in time.
weaknesses: You can only use this power on something that happened recently.
You cannot bring things into existence, merely suggest that it comes into existence.
You cannot travel in time, you can only change certain events

name: Flight
description:
The classic ability to fly.  No running start required.  You DO need to flap your arms to stay aloft, though.  You can travel at up to 60 MPH (or 100 KPH for you metric people), and you have heightened reflexes when traveling fast (or else you'd run into a lot of things).  

You CAN get hurt if you crash into something.
summary: The ability to fly.  Arm flapping is required.
strengths: Travel anywhere pretty quickly - no car needed
Fame and probably fortune
Get out of dangerous situations easily
weaknesses: Getting sucked into a plane turbine
Running into power lines
You might become famous, which would mean you get a lot of attention

name: Serpent Staff
description: This staff was made by aztec gods. It looks like a golden wing serpent with a ruby eyes and a sapphire gem in its mouth. When thorwned on the ground it turns into a 60 ft flying serpent which can be used to travel on and when hold the sapphire gem it turns the staff into a a rainbow blade.
summary: The ability to transform in to a 6o ft winged serpent or a sword made of refracted light
strengths: Fly around on the gaint snake
Turn the staff into a combat light sword
weaknesses: Sapphire isthe source of power
Staff can be stolen

name: Zone Mirror
description: Any reflection is able to open the gateway.  You have to touch the reflection for it to open.  In the mirror zone, one can not be harmed or touched. But be warned he who enters has no guarantee that he will be able to leave the zone again.  You can only leave the zone if you know an exit and posses the power to open these portals.  Those who lack the power are stuck in this zone forever. Unless you know how to teleport.
summary: The ability to open a gateway into the Mirror dimension.
strengths: You can hide in a place where almost nobody is able to get.
Send enemies into an nigh-unescapeable prison.
Reflections are everywhere so there are many place in wich you can hide.
weaknesses: Blurry reflections might corrupt you as you travel from your current realm into the mirror zone.
If you forget how to leave the zone you risk getting stuck forever.
In this zone pain is joy, when you bleed you won't feel pain but you're still approaching death.

name: Flying Cars
description: With this power you can give any vehicle the ability to fly and you will instantly know how to fly it. You can make cars, boats, submarines, bikes, scooters, wingless planes, rotorless helicopters etc. The ability to soar through the skies at whatever speed they were able to go one the ground/water/space.
summary: The ability to give any vehicle the ability to fly
strengths: You can give vehicles the ability to fly
You will know how to fly them
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You only know how to fly vehicles you've already used this power on

name: Distance Locker
description: When you activate this power, your current distance with your target will be locked. So, if one of you tries to get near or away, it would push away or drag the other to keep the distance between you constant. And if the latter tries to resist, the former will feel the resistance. Used effectively, you could prevent anyone from getting close or away, keep a safe distance from something or someone, or avoid being flown or teleported far away by locking your distance with the ground.
summary: The ability to lock your distance with something/someone, so neither of you can get near or away from the other.
strengths: You can severely impede someone else's movements.
Coupled with Superhuman Speed, you can drag someone to death.
Coupled with Superstrength, you can push/drag anything or anyone without touching them.
weaknesses: You can severely impede your own movements.
If your opponent has Superhuman Speed, they can drag you to death.
If your opponent has Superstrength, they can push/drag you without touching you.

name: Under Mass
description: Anything with less mass than you is now a simple extension of your will. I'm fond of example, so let's say you have an apple. You can move the apple, teleport it, send it through time, change it into an orange, disintegrate it, clone it, change its DNA structure, or do anything else with it you can imagine. But there are rules. You can't convert something into something living unless it was alive to begin with. And you can't control anything that has more mass than yourself.
summary: The ability to control anything with less mass than yourself
strengths: Very powerful
The more you can imagine, the more you can do.
weaknesses: No creating life
