Upon entering and exiting phasewalk you emit a "phaseblast" which damages everything around you. You may exit phasewalk at anytime. You may only use phasewalk for 30 seconds and after every use you must wait 5 seconds before you may use it again
summary: The ability to use Liltih's Phasewalk
strengths: Very versatile power
Phaseblast makes up for lack offensive choices in phasewalk
Great for sneaking into or outof hostile groups or just getting around
weaknesses: Cool down on use may be annoying
Your phaseblast may damage allies or items wanted undamaged

name: Gravity Thief
description: With this power, you can "steal" the gravity from different places of the world. You do this by importing gravitons and controlling the direction that they "carry" gravity. For example, if you steal the gravity from the other side of the world, you will fall upwards! If you steal the gravity from the place 90 degrees to your left (in the middle of the opposite side and you), you will fall left! With mastery, you can fall multiple directions in mere seconds.
summary: The ability to "steal" the gravity from different parts of the world.
strengths: You can fly in any direction you want! (Although it's more falling with direction).
You can use this power to walk on ceilings, walls, the undersides of staircases.
Not all objects are affected by the gravitons; only whoever or whatever you want, and yourself.
weaknesses: Takes practice to learn how to manoeuvre through the air.
You move through the air at the same speed as falling. There is no slowing down, or speeding up.
Falling to your left (or right), but not stopping and falling out of the atmosphere.

name: Myth Power: Teumessian Fox Trot
description: The Teumessian Fox, in Greek myth, was a magical fox who was fated never to be caught by any pursuer, regardless of their speed. As such, channeling him allows one to move with speed that adapts to outdo any any subject that pursues him; likewise, one's reflexes, friction/wind resistance, etc adapt to handle changes in speed. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command foxes at will. One can even turn into any breed of fox, or mimic the abilities of a fox at will.
summary: The ability to channel the superhuman evasion prowess of the mythical Teumessian Fox
strengths: Adapt speed, reflexes and wind/friction resistance to avoid any pursuer
Psychically perceive, communicate with and command foxes
Turn into any breed of fox, or mimic the abilities of a fox at will
weaknesses: Every hear of the tale of Laelaps and the Teumessian Fox? Look it up.
Speed/athletics/competition-based MythPowers provide immunity
MythPower: Artemis' Gift and other animal-based MythPowers (may provide immunity and/or control)

name: Myth Power: Hermes' Hustle
description: Hermes, in Greek myth, was the god of travel, messengers, trade, thievery, cunning wiles, language, writing, diplomacy, athletics, and animal husbandry, as well as Messenger to the Gods, and Guide to the Underworld. As such, channeling him allows one to have superhuman speed; one can even run over water, on air, and up walls. In addition, one becomes adept at using deceptive, sneaky language to trick people, as well as pickpocketing, stealth, athletics and numerous chthonic, underworld pursuits.
summary: The ability to channel Hermes' command over the essence of commerce, cunning, athletics, theft and travel
strengths: Superhuman lickety-quickness (even running over water, on air, and up walls; super reflexes as well)
Expert at lying, stealth (sneaking around/hiding), pickpocketing, and athletics (sports)
Immune to necromantic/death effects; perceive, communicate with and banish/ward off/exorcise spirits
weaknesses: Cannot evade Lie Detection or speak all languages (animal, etc) until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot peer into, and travel to/from the Astral Realms at will until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPowers based on the 12/13 Olympian gods can be used to summon you, when they are developed (NCN)

name: Particle Copy
description: With the power to copy particle properties, you can make your car act like a tachyon and travel faster than light or make your homework into a neutrino. Whatever a particle can do, or should do, you can make stuff do it!
summary: The ability to make objects act like particles.
strengths: You can do almost anything!
Very powerful.
weaknesses: Must know the particle to copy its properties.
Very dangerous if used wrongly.

name: Hitchhiker's Aptitude
description: Whenever someone or something is moving very fast, they leave behind a trail which the user can see and can instantly travel along, but only in the direction the object or person took. The trail can remain from a few seconds to minutes before disappearing. The user can catch a ride from anywhere the trail is available to wherever they want along the trail. In the case of teleportation or time travel, the user can only catch a ride from the spot where the teleporter or time traveller disappeared.
summary: The ability to hitch a ride with any fast-moving object or person, even through time and space.
strengths: Pursue anyone who tries to flee by running away, by car or any other vehicle.
Follow anyone who is superspeeding, superjumping, flying, teleporting or even time travelling.
You can ride the trail from anywhere it's accessible and leave anywhere along the way.
weaknesses: The trail disappears after a few seconds to minutes.
Against teleporters or time travellers, the trail is only accessible where the person disappeared.
Though you travel instantly along the trail, you can only move in the same direction that was took.

name: Time Loop
description: This ability allows the user to travel back to any specific point in time where they existed. They will inhibit the body of their past-self. The user has control over how long that length of time is, so it can be a day, weeks, months, or even years. After the designated period has ended, time resets, and the person is transported back to the beginning of they length of time they chose. Once the power is used, the user is trapped in the chosen time period forever.
summary: The ability to travel back to a certain point in time repeatedly
strengths: The ability to relive the glory days over and over again.
The ability to change moments in time to make them better.
Technical immortality.
weaknesses: Might have to relive bad moments over and over again, and it could get boring after awhile.
Changes made to the timeline are never permanent.
Forever trapped in a specific moment in time.

name: Future  Damages
description: This power lets you choose a future date for when the damage of any attack is going to affect you. You have to know when you're going to be hurt or the power won't work. You can delay death with this power if someone disintegrated you. You can't choose any time more than two years into the future from the time you would have actually been injured or killed. You can't choose the same future time for every injury or a possible death. This a extremely limited time travel power.
summary: The ability to push any injuries done to you to a future time.
strengths: You can call a hospital and let them know when to be ready.
It's actually good that this power isn't activated your instinct or subconscious.
weaknesses: Deciding what injuries to hurt you now or later in a fight could be tough.
Foes with a time control power.

name: Irresistable Pick Up
description: A person with this power can make anyone pick up anything they drop. This power is akin to the effect of the Golden Apples from Greek mythology that affected Atalanta. Anything you drop will induce people nearby to try and pick it up. This even overrides survival instinct as you can throw something off a cliff and people around you will jump and try to pick it up. This power will not affect those that do not see the object. If you throw multiple objects people will go toward the one closest.
summary: The ability to make people compulsively pick up anything you drop or throw
strengths: Instant distractions
Can prevent fragile things from being broken if picked up on time
Can get people's attention
weaknesses: Power duration ends when the object thrown has been picked up
Cannot be turned off
Affects all people around you unless they cannot see the object thrown

name: Bite The Bullet
description: You can only shoot the amount of bullets that you consume. And if you eat all different kinds of bullets you can not control which kind of bullet will come out of your palm(if you only eat two kinds you can). You can shoot bullets at a unnatural speed if you concentrate. If you waste all of the bullets you consume you will be extremely tired and hungry.
summary: The ability to eat bullets of any gun and shoot them out of your palms
strengths: A defense at all times
Never need a gun (which you can lose at any time)
More comfortable than a gun
weaknesses: Need to buy bullets
Makes you extremly hungry and tired if you used up all the bullets in your body
Can connect to emotions if not learned to control naturally

name: Myth Power: Graces' Groove
description: These Charites (Kharites, Graces), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of parties and entertainment. As such, channeling Pandaisia (Banquets), one can summon food/drink (or teleport to anywhere with food/drink) at will. Channeling Paidia (Play, Amusement), one gains excellent gaming skill, and summon and animate toys at will. Channeling Pannychis (Pannykhis- All-Night Party or Festivity), one can teleport to any party, including all-night celebrations (raves, bonfires, sleepovers, etc) at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Charites' command over the essence of festivity and entertainment
strengths: Summon food and drink at will (or teleport to any location with food and drink at will)
Summon and animate toys/games (when developed, game characters) at will; become an awesome gamer
Teleport to any party, amusement park or any nighttime activities (raves, bonfires, etc) at will
weaknesses: Cannot restore rotten/spoiled/stale food or drinks with a touch until the higher levels (NCN)
Only turn objects/subjects into toys (or toys into their real-life versions) at higher levels (NCN)
Only travel into video games (or to board game-based worlds) or the like at the higher levels (NCN)

name: Negative Reincarnation
description: Project negative energy with one's mind in it. The negative being is a dark purple color. When the negative being is out, one is protected by an impenetrable force-field and one's eyes turn the same color as the negative being. Since it is energy, it can fly and phase through objects. The negative being can't stay out of one's body too long or it'll dissolve into nano-particles and be reincarnated into a positive being. However, if the two merge together, they become unstable and will explode.
summary: The ability to project one's negative energy into a human like-being
strengths: Can fly
Can phase through objects
weaknesses: Can't stay in negative being for a long time
Merging with positive equals explosion

name: Artifact: Joculatrix Monachans
description: When you say "Adeat", a pair of shoes appear on your feet. These shoes allow you to run extremely fast and enhance your agility.
summary: The ability to summon a pair of shoes that allow you to run extremely fast.
strengths: Can run on water.
Can run along walls.
Jumping power is increased.
weaknesses: Limited combat use.

name: Pathfinding
description: Pathfinding is a unique ability that allows you to sense exactly where you are in the world. You can never get lost, and will always be able to find your way to a place, even if you've never been there before. All you have to do is think about your destination to be able to get there, or think about yourself to determine where you are in the world.
summary: The ability to always know what your global position is.
strengths: You will never get lost.
You'll never need to use a GPS device ever again.
You can find your way through any maze or out of any building with ease.
weaknesses: While you can find your way to your destination, getting there is all on you.
A telepath can easily throw off this power.

name: Angelical Conquer
description: You have a pair of huge wings that are colored to your liking. You also control any type of crystal, ex. Ruby, obsidian, emerald, etc. Also, your wings are retractable, but it takes a lot of effort to master flight.
summary: The ability to have wings and control a type of crystal
strengths: You pick the type of crystal and wing color
Wings are retractable
You can fly for a short time
weaknesses: Once you pick a crystal you can't change it
You'll have an uncontrollable urge to wear a lot of jewelery
You might give your mom a heart attack

name: Improbable Staircase
description: Any staircase can become your own entrance to the Improbable Staircase. The Improbable Staircase is a set of stairs that exsists nowhere and everywhere at the same time. By traveling on the staircase and exiting on certain "landings" you can travel to anywhere on earth or its adjacent dimensions at any point in time. Traveling the Improbable Staircase is dangerous as it requires concentration and if concentration is lost you may "fall" off and end up stuck somwhere you don't want to be.
summary: The ability to turn any staircase into an entrace to the Improbable Staircase
strengths: Effectivly a portal to anywhere or anytime
Doubles as a portal to other dimensions
Great for getaways
weaknesses: Difficult to travel and reach your desired destination
You may end up in a bad place
Requires intense concentration

name: The Heart Of Rontu
description:
In a mysterious Native American language, Rontu means "grey wolf with yellow eyes". Legend has it, that an Indian girl named Karana was stranded on an island. She made friends with a wolf and named him Rontu. When the wolf died, she buried him. She was rescued from the island, but when she was going to dig up the wolf, she saw a wolf with yellow eyes running from the scene. 
Using this power allows the user to know every aspect of the wilderness. The dangers, the prey, the predators, etc.
summary: The ability to have superhuman knowledge of the wilderness
strengths: Know everything about nature
weaknesses: May have visions of a grey wolf with yellow eyes.

name: Snap You're Gone V1
description: With this power you can send a person to different country by snapping you fingers saying the person's name and the name of the country you want to send them to. The person doesn't even have to be near you and you can send them back by saying the person's name and the country he/she was in originally. You cannot use this power on yourself or other people with this power. Likewise this power cannot be used on you at all.
summary: The ability to send people to different countries by snapping
strengths: You can send people to different countries
You are immune to this power even if it is used by another person
weaknesses: You cannot use this power on yourself
You do not choose where in the country the person appears

name: Legendary Ice Dragon
description: Summon spell through imagination creating a real Ice flying dragon that you can control to deflect psychic and physical attacks, send ice blast and provide transportation for 1 hour duration.
summary: The ability to cast spell to create an Ice-breathing flying dragon by imagination.
strengths: Cool pet.
Turn enemies to block of ice
weaknesses: Weak against fire.
Short playtime.

name: Ability Augmentation
description: An Ability Augmenter can permanently enhance the abilities of others, granting new sub-abilities which branch off from their primary ability. A Telekinetic wouldn't be able to lift increased mass, but may be able to create telekinetic energy fields. A Speedster couldn't run any faster, but might be able to vibrate through walls, or make objects explode through vibration. Augmentation requires physical contact.
summary: The ability to expand upon pre-existing abilities
strengths: Granting friends enhanced forms of their abilities
You have some influence over the augmentation
You can augment an ability more than once
weaknesses: Requires physical contact
Being forced to augment the ability of an enemy
Augmenting an ability multiple times can make it unstable

name: Instant Moving
description: With this power you can move all of your possessions into one place. If the item was on a shelf/closet/bin/etc before you used the power it will be on a shelf/closet/bin/etc in the new location (if there is no shelf/closet/bin/etc in the new place or there are too many items to fit on the shelf/closet/bin/etc the item will appear on the floor). You can use this power as many times you want but it automatically moves every single thing you own.
summary: The ability to move all of your possessions to one place
strengths: You can move all of your possessions into one place
You can use it as many times as you want
weaknesses: It automatically moves every thing you own

name: Mortality Clause
description: With this power, you can deactivate all of your abilities and become mortal. However, you can choose to have your abilities reactivate under certain conditions, such as when the human race is threatened and you can reactivate them at will at any time. The power has access to all of your abilities; if you have super speed, it will process things as fast or faster than you would normally.
summary: The ability to negate your powers and become mortal, but revive in select conditions.
strengths: Age and die with your loved ones.
Immortality now only lasts as long as you want it to.
You can choose to die but be able to return if you are needed.
weaknesses: If you are not of a required power level, this is useless.
This power does not give any powers needed to make it valuable.
You can only deactivate all of your abilities; not just select ones.

name: Batman Vehicles
description: With this power you can turn into any of Batman's vehicles from any continuity such as the Batmobile, the Batwing, Batpod, Flying Batcave, Batsub etc. While in vehicle mode you have all of the weapons the vehicles have in the comics/movies/TV shows.
summary: The ability to turn into any of Batman's vehicles
strengths: You can turn into any Batman vehicle from any continuity
You have all of that vehicle's weapons
weaknesses: You can not revert to human mode if their are people riding inside of you
If you are destroyed in vehicle mode you die

name: Gigantic Swung Object
description: There is a large category of hand-held objects with a handle, such as baseball bats, flyswatters, hammers, handbags, whips, screwdrivers, swords, knives, tennis rackets, buckets, shovels, axes, mallets, clubs, etc. When the power user holds one by its handle and makes a swinging movement, the body of the object will suddenly gain mass and grow to enormous proportions while moving at the same speed as its original version would move. When the swinging stops, the object becomes normal again.
summary: The ability to make the body of hand-held objects with handles grow to enormous sizes when swung.
strengths: Afraid to miss the nail's head with a hammer? Just expand it! (But be careful about the wall! )
Annoyed by mosquitoes? Giant flyswatter! Just aim so they don't go through the vents.
Threatened by a mugger? Just swing your lady handbag to be sure to hit them.
weaknesses: If the object is a container, its contents won't expand, only the object does.
The object is only giant during the swing.

name: Artifact: Horaria Vortix
description: When you say "Adeat", an hourglass is summoned. It can delay things from happening. It creates a sphere of influence. Anyone inside of it will see things speed up on the outside. Anyone outside of it will see things inside slow down.
summary: The ability to control the flow of time in a certain area.
strengths: Good for strategic people.
Good for tricksters and sneaky people.
weaknesses: You are NOT immune to its power.

name: Every Other Power Not On List
description: A person with this power has every power that is not on the list of superpowerlist.com yet. Now this would normally be a terrible power, but in fact it is brilliant in the fact that the user does not even need to know what their powers are. If they think they want to fly, then they will although by alternate means. That means you have no idea how you did something even though you did it. So if some power has side effects then you don't know until you write it on the list-losing the power.
summary: The ability to have all the abilities that are not in the SuperpowerList currently
strengths: You have every power that is not listed on the website
You don't have to understand what your power is, you just use it
They are not going to run out of powers anytime soon so for now you have lots of powers
weaknesses: Once someone puts that power on the list you lose that power
This power constantly gets weaker
You don't know what power you are using or their consequences

name: App Power: Action Movie Fx
description: This power allows you to take the special effects offered by the video app Action Movie FX and turn them into reality. You can create classic effects, like a sinkhole to swallow your opponent, a demolition rock to crush him, or a meteor storm. There's also options from Call of Duty: Black Ops II, such as the Claw or EMPs. Finally, you can also create effects from Star Trek. Blast the enemy with phasers or torpedoes, or you can use the transporter and warp speed.
summary: The ability to turn the effects of Action Movie FX into reality
strengths: Attack with natural disasters, tear gas, missiles, robots, aliens, and other attacks
Use EMPs, transporters, or warp speed, or summon the Enterprise
As more effects are added, you get more powers
weaknesses: Limited by the effects available on the app
At low levels you need to concentrate for 5 seconds before creating the effect

name: Teleportation Immunity
description: With this power you will never be teleported to somewhere against your will ever again. You can resist teleporting machines, teleporting powers and teleporting creatures. You can turn this power on and off so you can be teleported to places if you want to.
summary: The ability to resist being teleported somewhere against your will
strengths: You will never be teleported to anywhere if you don't want to be teleported
You can resist teleporting machines, powers and creatures
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: Does not apply to teleporting to other dimensions or time periods

name: Healer 2: Paralysis Removal
description: This ability projects a 25 kilometer radius around the user. Within the field, people are cured of any form of paralysis. The more people it affects, the bigger the field is and the faster the user becomes. The user can switch it off. The longer the user has this power, the greater the range (expands 1 meter per year).
summary: The ability to relieve people of paralysis.
strengths: Allow people to walk again within 25 kilometers.
Gain super speed.
Can be deactivated at will.
weaknesses: Paralysis may return shortly after people leave the field.
Victims may not be able to perform normal functions due to atrophy anyway.
Unlike other healing powers, it cannot heal wounds or other ailments.

name: Bird Brain
description: When you want to fly without a plane, use this power. When you're a human bird-creature, you can fly so fast somewhere, you'll be saying "I just flew from so-and-so and man, are my arms tired" when you get there.
summary: The ability to The ability fly, change into a humanoid bird, and can use a sonic screech
strengths: Be a man-bird
Can fly at fast speeds
Can use a super screech
weaknesses: Can't always use when in the cold
You can be thrown around by jet-streams

name: Super Enhanced Pack
description: Like the Enhanced Pack Invulnerability power but the number of the group boosts any power or powers of any group member. The exception is strength powers.  Ex: 5 people in an enhanced pack. One has a running speed of 90 mph and one can fly 300 mph. The runner now runs 450 mph (unless friction is a problem) and the flier goes 1500 mph. Some powers might not benefit due to the fact they're as good as they get, boosting the power wouldn't make any sense or a power can't be modified.
summary: The ability to have all the members of an enhanced pack get a power boost equal to the number of the group.
strengths: An enhanced pack with enhanced powers.
weaknesses: Certain powers may not get the power boost.

name: Demon Power Set
description: You will be able to have an incredible demon power set. These powers include: Teleportation, Demon Push, Demon Pull, Black Fire Blast, Super Speed and Wings.
summary: The ability to have a demon power set
strengths: Great Defence
Great Stregth
Great Stamina
weaknesses: Sensitive to Light
Weak against vampires

name: Blade Ankle Wings V2
description: With this power you can sprout two wings from both of your ankles. The wings allow you to fly and also give you enhanced speed. The wings can also shoot our small silver blades that can pierce anything. The blades cannot be used against you.
summary: The ability to sprout wings that shoot sharp blades from your ankles
strengths: You can sprout wings from your feet
You have enhanced speed
You can shoot blades from the wings on your feet
weaknesses: Nothing really

name: Teleport To Master
description: With this power you can teleport straight to wherever your master is whether it is 100 yards away or on the other side of the universe. Doesn't matter whether what kind of a master they are or whether or not you want them to be your master. Also works if you acknowledge them as your master but they don't acknowledge themself as your master.
summary: The ability to teleport to where one's master is located at
strengths: You can help your master whenever they need help.
You can make it to classes on time (teacher).
weaknesses: You are unable to teleport back home.
You cannot teleport to other dimensions until the higher levels.

name: Guardian Helmet
description: Once a user wears the Guardian helmet, the source of power and recognition for the intergalactic peace force known as the Guardian Corps,he or she will be granted its power which includes the ability to fly, survive in space, limited invulnerability, scanning abilities, database access to the Guardian's database and the ability to create hardlight constructs via the Guardian star that serves as the helmet's power souce
summary: The ability to be bestowed powers by the Guardian Helmet
strengths: Can take on most if not all powerhouses
Symbol of peace, justice
Highly versatile
weaknesses: The star that powers the helmet must be charged once its power has been exhausted
Dislodging the helmet from the user will depower the user. Although this is near impossible to do.

name: Self Storage
description: This may be one of the best melee powers ever. You can store yourself in any object that you can lift with one hand and reappear at any point on it. So if you have a long pole, you can disappear from one side and reappear on the other. You can hold a marble and throw it with yourself inside, allowing for easy travel. You can stay inside for as long as you like without aging, and see everything that happens outside of the object. However, if the object is destroyed, so are you.
summary: The ability to store yourself in a hendheld object indefinitely
strengths: Awesome melee power
Semi-immortality
Great for spying
weaknesses: Must be an inanimate object that you can lift with one hand, not good for weak people
Object cannot be destroyed

name: Talent Granting
description: A talent is a group of aptitudes useful for some activity, or qualities that make someone who has them espically good at a certain thing. A talent granter can imbue someone with these qualities. They cannot, however, imbue anyone with qualities beyond normal human capabilities, such as intangibility or flight.
summary: The ability to imbue others with talents or special skills.
strengths: Can grant anyone with a talent of your choice.
It is possible to grant yourself a talent, at the expense of losing this ability
weaknesses: Contact is required
Can't grant super-human qualities
Can't grant more than one talent per person, but you can take a talent back.

name: Cat Tastrophe
description: This power will allow you to have extend-able claws, jump incredibly accurately and "fft!" at your enemy.
summary: The ability to have all the powers of a feline.
strengths: Conceal your claws easily.
weaknesses: You are easily frightened by Dogs.

name: Object Splitting
description: You can split any object in two by running your finger around it in a complete loop. It will split along the line you draw. If you have a hollow object, the two halves will act as if still connected. For instance, if you split a straw, you can put one half in a drink and drink remotely through the other half. In this way, you can remove your limbs and operate them from a distance. However, once the object is split, it cannot be rejoined. You could put some tape around it but it wouldn't be same.
summary: The ability to split objects and form portals between the two halves
strengths: Split any object in two easily
Operate limbs remotely
Perpetual motion now possible
weaknesses: Must be able to draw a complete, non-stop line around the object
Object can never be truly rejoined
Portals only available with hollow objects

name: Monkey King (Sun Wukong)
description: With this ability, you become the monkey king, Sun Wukong himself. In the story, Journey to the West the Monkey King was a master shapeshifter knowing over 72 different transformations. He was also a master martial artist with superb strength. His staff, known as Ruyi Jingu Bang was capable of reaching incredible lenghts. Sun can also fly upon a cloud for traveling. With this ability you are nearly invincible and immortal.
summary: The ability to become a legendary figure from Chinese mythology.
strengths: The spells are quite powerful.
Use your cloud for short trips.
It is good to be immortal.
weaknesses: The transformations are imperfect, your tail is still noticeable.
You are still prone to damage and can feel pain.
A habit to play pranks on others.

name: Ability Jump Start
description: This power is not cancellable as it would obviously defeat its purpose. It allows you to use any of your powers when they should be cancelled. It doesn't restore your lost abilities though. You can choose more than one power to jump-start. Once you are done with a power, you can release it, in which case it becomes cancellable again.
summary: The ability to jump-start your abilities that have been cancelled.
strengths: You can use your powers against power negators.
This power cannot be cancelled.
weaknesses: Useless if your powers aren't cancelled in the first place.
This power can still be removed/stolen.

name: Bullet Catching V2
description: With this power whenever you're shot at the bullet will instantly fly into your hand and since this power makes your hands impervious to bullets you'll be perfectly fine. However if you're holding something when someone takes a shot at you the bullet will probably destroy whatever you were holding.
summary: The ability to cause bullets to fly into your hand and be perfectly ok
strengths: Your hands are impervious to bullets
Bullets instantly fly towards your hand when you're shot at
weaknesses: If you're holding something when you're shot at the thing will probably be destroyed

name: Car Chase
description: With this power you will be able to go at the same exact speed of the car or truck that you are pursuing (providing that you yourself are in a car or a truck). You will only be able to match the speed the vehicle is currently moving at when you use the power not its potential speed. You don't even need gasoline in your car for this power to work.
summary: The ability to match the speed of any car/truck that your are pursuing
strengths: You will be able to match the speed of any car or truck that you chasing
You can come in second place in any competitive car race
No gasoline required
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You cannot use this power on bikes, planes, tanks, boats, helicopters, motorcycles, skates, scooters
You need to be in a car or truck for this power to work

name: Medicated
description: With this power a drug's claim is taken literally. Pain relievers allow you to control your pain and the pain of others. Sleeping pills allow you to induce sleep. Allergy medicine allow you to make anyone allergic to whatever you choose, etc. Recreational drugs are mostly dangerous but have varying effects. All abilities last until the drug runs its course.
summary: The ability to gain abilities from pills
strengths: The range of your powers is dependant on dosage
Multivitamins will enhance abilities gained from medications
Steroids, HGH and muscle builders will take you beyond any top athlete
weaknesses: Medications must be in pill form and you still have to come up with the co-pay

summary: The ability to execute three mid-air horizontal roundhouse kicks.
strengths: Can kick your enemy to the curve three times.
weaknesses: If the opponent avoids it, you'll miss by doing a third one and fall down hard.

name: Transformers; Prowl
description: With this power you can turn any vehicle that you are operating into a police car. Chasing an enemy? Running late for an appointment? Turn you car into a police car to eliminate traffic. Want to park anywhere? Police car. Want people to drive really slowly and cautiously around you? Police car.
summary: The ability to turn any vehicle into a police car
strengths: You can turn any vehicle that you are operating into a police car
weaknesses: Only vehicles that you are operating
You might get in trouble with the actual police

name: Multi Headed Swung Object
description: There is a large category of hand-held objects with a handle, such as hammers, whips, swords, knives, tennis rackets, shovels, axes, mallets, etc. When the power user holds one by its handle and makes a swinging movement, the body of the object will suddenly multiply while moving at the same speed as its original version would move. For example, swinging a sword will create a sword with multiple blades coming out of a single hilt. When the swinging motion stops, the object becomes normal again.
summary: The ability to make the body of hand-held objects with handles duplicate when swung.
strengths: Have a sword? Why go for the kill when you can go for the overkill with this power?
You can control in which directions the object will be duplicated.
weaknesses: If the object is a container, its contents won't multiply, only the container does.
The body of the object is only duplicated during the swing.
The duplicated parts remain attached to the handle.

name: Backsliding
description: Ever get stuck in a massive crowd, unable to move? Worry no longer! With this ability, just hop on the ground, and start sliding at walking speed! Become unstoppable! However, normal friction rate occurs and it will hurt quite a bit. But why let that get you down! WARNING: DO NOT KNOCK OVER PEOPLE WITH HIGH HEELS ON, OTHERWISE YOU WON'T BE DOING MUCH SLIDING ANYMORE.
summary: The ability to slide around the ground on your back!
strengths: Get places faster than you would walking.
Trip people you don't like over.
Impress your friends!
weaknesses: You are vunerable to 'steppings on'.
The back of your shirt will be gone.
So will multiple layers of back-skin.

name: Angry Birds V2
description: With this power you have an unlimited amount of every kind of space angry bird from the game Angry Birds Space. When you use this power a small one way portal opens up and shoots out as many of any kind of space angry bird as you want. After the birds are launched from the portal, a remote with different buttons (one for each kind of space angry bird) appears in your hand and pushing the button will activate the birds' special power (freezing, multiplying etc). You can send them back later
summary: The ability to summon any amount of any kind of Space Angry Bird
strengths: You can summon any of the space Angry Birds
weaknesses: The birds can be killed

name: The Phantom Tollbooth
description: With this power you can summon the Phantom Tollbooth and use it to travel to the Kingdom of Knowledge. You can keep the tollbooth for as long as you want and send it away when you're done with it. Once you send it away however you cannot bring it back and you lose this power. Alternatively if this power is stolen from you somehow the tollbooth disappears as well.
summary: The ability to summon the Phantom Tollbooth and use it to go to the Kingdom
strengths: You can send yourself and others into the Kingdom of Knowledge
You can keep the tollbooth for as long as you want
weaknesses: Once you unsummon the Tollbooth you can never bring it back
If this power is stolen from you, you lose the tollbooth as well

name: Greater Kystian Morph #3
description: Become a zelet from emergency power #6. A 650-foot hybrid of a whale and a squid. Each of your eight limbs can lift 1500 tons. Your flight is telekinetic in nature. If flight is lost, you can still crawl on the ground. You have telescopic vision and sonar. Your speed in the air is 550 mph, in space 5500 mph and on land 20 mph. If you can build a weapon big enough to use, you can use one in this form. Deactivating this power causes unconsciousness.
summary: The ability to become a unsummonable flying kystian.
strengths: Be a giant flying monster.
If you can make a weapon big enough to use as this monster, you can use it.
You can fly into space.
weaknesses: You need a pal to help when you switch off of this form.

name: Make A Kystian
description: You get 300 lbs of material every time you use this power. You can't use the power again until you use the material or it is destroyed or it is lost. You can make one or as many kystians as you can. Make them too small and get kystians with a hive IQ. You'll have to balance speed and strength. No superkystian. You can give your creatures sub-powers based on your powers. There is a maximum of 5 powers. There are off limit powers. Your creatures can walk,slither,swim or/and fly.
summary: The ability to make a kystian of your own.
strengths: Make a really good creature and Kyst will mass produce it.
Any appearance is possible. Off limit power have no affect on appearance.
weaknesses: Off limit powers include are mythic,holy,unholy,time travel,time reversal.
Elemental body powers and cartoon based powers are off limits.
Any other powers that might be questionable for a kystian creature to have.

name: Silly Putty Man
description: At will you can change into Silly Putty Man or Woman. You gain all the characteristics of Silly Putty, you can bounce, stretch, flow like a slow moving liquid.
summary: The ability to change into Silly Putty.
strengths: Can get through tight places.
Ability to bounce high, to gain access to high places.
weaknesses: Heavy impacts will cause you to shatter.
Any type of alcohol changes you into a gum like substance.

name: Extreme Knot Maker
description: Ever get tired of having knots in your laces or bending over to retie them. Well say goodbye to that dismal moment. Extreme Knot Maker lets you make any knot known to man with extreme speed and ease. Figure eight, pretzel, Apache chief pipe smoking ritual knot, you got them all, so long as mankind has made them before.
summary: The ability to create any knot with ease
strengths: Tie your shoes with ease
Go rock climbing with confidence you won't die
Break the world record for knot tying with time to spare
weaknesses: Nearly useless in fighting
Limited to the knots known to mankind

name: Tele Apathy
description:
Tele-Apathic people couldn't care less about you or your problems. While many people display versions of this power in their everyday lives, Tele-Apathics (or "Shmanners" for convenience) have a super-humanly extended range. 

Famous shmanners include Peter Petrelli, who, despite having time travel, didn't care enough to stop time whenever attacked. Also D. L. Hawkins, a phaser who doesn't mind being shot point blank from the front.
summary: The ability to not care from far away.
strengths: It's a lot less stressful than other powers
weaknesses: You could die
Whoops, I mean you will die

name: Summon Nitra
description: A nitra is a upright monster that looks like the offspring of pterodactyl and a sea anemone. It can fly 10 mph,run 30 mph and is strong enough to cut through titanium. It has long talons on the end of its wings/arms. It has the ability to only exist for its summoner and a sentient target of attack. It can't affect or be affected in any way by other beings or creatures when in that state. If its summoner is rendered unconscious a nitra dies instantly if in that state.
summary: The ability to summon a limited existing kystian.
strengths: A kystian that can literally only exist to kill.
You can make this kystian undetectable to its target. Invisible,silent,etc.
The target of a nitra is the only being that can affect it with or without powers.
weaknesses: If you're made unconscious any nitras you have could die.
A nitra can only go after one target in its limited existence state.

name: Traveler's Curse
description: You know someone can leap through time, speed up time, slow time down, or stop time. You can curse this person. From now on each time they use their power they will be sick to their stomach and throw up. It gets worse and worse each time after until they just cant stand it.
summary: The ability to make time travelers increasingly sick with each leap through time.
strengths: Make time travelers sick.
It gets worse each time they use their power.
Eventually they stop using their power.
weaknesses: Stupid or stubborn time travelers will either die from sickness or kill themselves.

name: Killer Smile
description: Gives the user the ability to do a really terrifying shark-like smile, it does this by sharpening the users teeth and making them into feral points and contorting your expression into a horrific smile. In the process also giving the user gills and or scales to make them look kind of fish-like.   It is best used to warn off enemies or to creep them out.
summary: The ability to grow Shark-like Teeth
strengths: Gives you the most awesome creepy smile ever.
You'll become a very fast swimmer.
You can become a menacing half-human-half-shark beast.
weaknesses: The smile only works if your mouth is open.
You can't be a Mer-shark.
You have to be near water before you go into shark beast form or you will dry up.

name: Jump To 12:34:56 7/8/9
description: You may or may not have realized it, but a glorious event has just occurred. On July 8, at exactly 12:34:56 PM, the time and date was 12:34:56 7/8/9. At this moment, you may have felt slightly more aware of your surroundings, or may have even felt an overwhelming, fleeting sense of profoundness. With this power, you have a direct link to these moments in time, & can teleport yourself to them! If you didn't exist at your destination, your current body & everything in a 3 in radius is teleported.
summary: The ability to teleport through time to any moment where the time and date is 12:34:56 7/8/9
strengths: Teleporting to the recent 12:34:56 7/8/9 places you in your body at that time.
Teleporting to the recent 12:34:56 7/8/9 gives you a chance to redo the past
Experience the profoundness of this moment over and over again!
weaknesses: You can only jump to these specific points in time (12:34:56 7/8/9), which happen every 100 years
You must travel alone
You can only bring your clothing and small belongings

name: Summon Telygot
description: Telygots look like shrew-hummingbird hybrid bipeds. They have winged flight. They're a blur when flying or running. They have a hummingbird's reaction time. They have touch-only pyrokinesis that is hot enough to melt steel. Telygots also have sonar. They can run 350 mph and fly 300 mph. They can lift 5 tons. They are hyperactive beings. The longer a telygot goes without seeing action, the worse the collateral damage is going to be when a fight does happen. It is summoned with weapons.
summary: The ability to summon a flying pyrokinetic kystian.
strengths: Telygots have an inhumanly fast reaction.
Telygots would make great bodyguards.
Telygots can melt steel.
weaknesses: Telygots are hyperactive.
The pyrokinesis is touch only.

name: Greater Kystian Morph #9
description: You change into a zairi. You're 40 feet long. You look like a mix of mythological dragon and venus fly trap. You have a mane but one made of rose petals. Your claws of thorns and your body is covered with thorns. You have the power to exhale a misty cloud of pseudo-pollen that destroys solid and liquid non-Kyst reality. You can carry 14 tons using both sets of claws. Your bite strength is equal to that of 10 sharks. You fly 30 mph and run 20 mph.
summary: The ability to become a flying plantlike kystian.
strengths: A limited reality destruction power.
Incredible biting strength.
You can fly.
weaknesses: There are powers that can affect winged flight.
You can't destroy non-solid or non-liquid non-Kyst reality.
This form needs room to be useless.

name: Kystian Multiples Mayhem
description: Summon up to 19 hira or a single pack of 114 flickerspawn or 380 swiftslices to do your bidding. You select before summoning how many over the normal number you want, but you can't just unsummon one you have to unsummon the entire summoned group, if need be.
summary: The ability to multiple by 9 to 19 the normal number of kystians you summon.
strengths: Up to 380 swiftslices that stay until you unsummon them.
Summon 19 armed and dangerous slaypassions as full-time bodyguards.
weaknesses: Unsummoned as a group.

name: Corpse Locator
description: The ability to make a corpse lead you to it's murderer. The corpse will use any method of transportation available to them.
summary: The ability to make a corpse lead you to it's murderer.
strengths: You'll always find the murderer
weaknesses: It would scare people to see a dead person get up and start walking. (or take the bus).
The murderer might try to kill you when you get to them.

name: Random Time Travel
description: This power causes a time traveler to go to a completely random time rather than one of his or her choosing every time s/he time travels. The effect is temporary if you want the traveler to risk possibly death or injury. Permanent if the traveler won't suffer any harm or death when they time travel. If you can be considered a threat to a victim of this power than the victim will never appear in the same time period that you exist.
summary: The ability to randomize where in time someone goes when they time travel.
strengths: Get rid of for good time traveling enemies that are weaker than you.
Temporarily get rid of time traveling enemies that aren't weaker than you.
weaknesses: Time defiance or powers like it provide immunity to this power(NCN).
Weaker time jumping enemies could still find a way to get you.

name: Summon Flock Of Tilar
description: A tilar looks like a mix of a scorpion, a bat and a hawk with a 12 ft wingspan. A tilar is smart, has a whip-like tail that's 20 ft long, which can be used like a real whip. A tilar can snap its tail with enough speed to break reality. Anything hit made of solid matter and weighing 300 lbs or less will cease to exist. Tilar have sonar and telescopic vision. A tilar is immune to the effect of its own tail or other tilars' tails. Other anti-reality powers affect tilars.
summary: The ability to summon a flock of ten flying kystians.
strengths: A limited reality-destruction power.
A tail hit can still do damage to a target.
weaknesses: Non-humanoids can't use weapons.
Environments that don't work for flying creatures.
A tail can be grabbed by a foe.

name: Summon Nalyz
description: Nalyzes look like men reshaped into bipedal ants. They have the power to resist forced teleportation and time travel. Time reversal or time travel attempts to have made you never summon it to begin with will fail. You can unsummon a nalyz the normal way. They appear with four pistols, one for each hand. Any small objects a nalyz carries are also immune to being teleported. Nalyzes know how to use rifle weapons. Nalyzes can run 40 mph and lift 20 tons.
summary: The ability to summon the other kystian no one remove from your side.
strengths: Merge a nalyz and a zalt(nalt? ,zalyz? )and get a kystian no one will remove from your side.
This kystian can use four weapons at once.
Have this kystian carry important things you don't want be teleported by a foe.
weaknesses: This kystian is only summoned pistol weapons.

name: Pee Teleporter
description: Well if someone makes you angry put pee on them. You can do it to anyone in the world at anytime.
summary: The ability to teleport pee
strengths: Pee on anyone of course
Put pee in their brain and kill them
weaknesses: There has to be pee around to teleport it

name: Cowardly
description: You have a passive 'panic' ability. Upon being attacked, your speed increases and you're more resistant to damage for a short time. However you will also be compelled to run as fast as possible away from the attacker(s), but those with strong willpower can resist this urge. Speed and resistance last for half a minute but with practice can persist for over five minutes.
summary: The ability to flee a dangerous situation
strengths: Speed and defense will be boosted upon injury
Getting away from a dangerous situation is made easier
weaknesses: Urge to run can be irresistable
Boosts only last half a minute at first

name: Thirteen Treasures: Chariot.
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. Upon entering the chariot, and stating a destination, the chariot will carry its rider there in the blink of an eye.
summary: The ability to command the chariot of Morgan the Wealthy
strengths: Fast-travel anywhere! Sort of!
weaknesses: The chariot will only recognize the names of places that existed during Arthur's reign.
No travelling to the new-world (USA, South America, Australia)

name: Kystian Quadruplets
description: This power requires the Kystian Triplets power to work. You can get 4 times the regular number of kystians when you use a power to summon kystians. You can have 4 slitskins or 80 swiftslices, or even a pack of 24 flickerspawn that will probably never be killed because all of them have to be killed at the same time.
summary: The ability to multiple by 4 the normal number of kystians you summon.
strengths: 24 flickerspawn at your command.
weaknesses: Space to keep your extra monsters is starting to become a problem.

name: Delete This Hollow Elbow
description: You could simply dash forward and knocks your foe backwards with an elbow. You can swiftly run behind the enemy and deliver a successful elbow into their face, and/or teleport behind your opponent as you connect with an elbow leaving behind a burst of smoke when you vanish.
summary: The ability to invertedly dash forward or do a teleport attack followed by an elbow.
strengths: not a power
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Bat Ankle Wings
description: You possess brownish-black leather wings on both of your ankles - they enables you to fly extremely fast.
summary: The ability to possess leather bat like wings on your ankles.
strengths: You can look like a mix of Dracula and Namor.
You can fly
weaknesses: Shoe shopping will take ages.
Until you get used to it, you might have trouble controlling it
You might not have fast reactions

name: Myth Power: Taraxippos' Terror
description: Taraxippos (Taraxippus) and the Taraxippoi, in Greek myth, were the gods of horses' fear (especially during the Olympian games and other races). As such, channeling them allows one to absorb psychic energy from fear, doubt, anxiety and superstition to form into a pseudo-sentient horse construct. In addition, the construct is immune to fear, as is the rider, when mounted. One can even use the construct to ride through the Nightmare Dimension (as a form of Teleportation, Time Travel, etc) at will.
summary: The ability to channel Taraxippos and the Taraxippoi's command over the essence of horses' fear
strengths: Form psychic energy from fear/doubt/anxiety/superstition (of self/others) into a horse construct
Horse construct is immune to fear and fear effects, as is the rider (when mounted)
Ride horse construct through the Nightmare Dimension (for Teleportation, Time Travel, etc)
weaknesses: Horse construct cannot be reserved for self/allies (or multiplied) until the higher levels (NCN)
Only turn foe into horse under the user's fear-fueled control, by touch, at the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige, MythPower: Artemis' Gift, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Summon Iqa
description: A iqa looks a like half woman,half wolf. A she wolf satyroid. Her howl carries a meme of her personality. Any living thing hearing the howl that the iqa saw hearing the howl will be taken over by the meme-personality. Immunity to sound, vibration or mind control powers protect against the howl. Hearing the howl through a device also gives immunity. The effect of the howl lasts an hour. Iqa can lift 6 tons,run 40 mph and jump 15 feet. Iqa have the senses of a wolf.
summary: The ability to summon a sound-based meme using kystian.
strengths: Temporary meme-kystians to do your bidding.
weaknesses: Anyone immune as per description,people hearing through device,deaf people
A iqa does have to see through her own eyes that her howl was heard.

name: Super Cardboard Cutout Form
description: With this power, you can turn into a cardboard cutout that looks just like you and can still see things. While in this form, You gain an immunity to physical pain (no nerves) and mental attacks (no brain), and don't bleed. You can also fly up to 10 feet off the ground, traveling at a maximum of 20 mph. You also gain telekinetic powers with a 3 foot range. However, the user can be easily damaged, since you're weak cardboard, and the damage taken will carry over when you turn back into a human.
summary: The ability to become a superpowered cardboard cutout of yourself.
strengths: Can gain limited superpowers while cardboard
Immune to most torture techniques while cardboard
You can put yourself on display
weaknesses: You cannot move when you are cardboard (no muscles)
Virtually useless in defense and offense
Cardboard isn't very strong

name: Kystian Octuplets
description: This power requires the Kystian Septuplets power to work. So, you can summon 8 sludge trees, 8 norr, 8 carnallures, 8 slitskins, a single pack of 48 flickerspawn and 160 swiftslices, plus eight times the regular number of any new kystian monsters that may come into existence. That's what you can summon.
summary: The ability to multiple by 8 the normal number of kystians you summon.
strengths: 240 (and counting) monsters to summon.
weaknesses: You'll need the biggest hideout you can find.

name: Summon Xepur
description: Xepurs look like lamprey-leech humanoids. One arm has a long curved claw from the forearm. The xepur can attack with this claw but when outside of Kyst it can use the claw to rip open tears to other dimensions,excluding Kyst. The summoner and any allies go through first. When the xepur goes through a dimensional vortex pulls everything in no bigger than motorcycle sending objects to random dimensions. The vortex has a radius of 500 feet,it last 30 seconds. Xepurs can lift 6 tons,run 30 mph.
summary: The ability to summon a dimension traveling kystian.
strengths: A kystian with two dimensional powers in one.
weaknesses: You work with too many people.
You care about innocent bystanders.

name: Toilet Paper Teleport
description: You have the ability to teleport from one side of the sheet of toilet paper to the other side. If it breaks you will only teleport till that break point. Works with 1 ply and 2 ply, so no worries.
summary: The ability to teleport through toilet paper one sheet at a time.
strengths: You can escape bullies.
You can teepee somes house with ease and never get caught.
Noone exppects you to have this power till you use it.
weaknesses: It would suck if you accidently teleport through used toilet paper.
Any enemies could easily "pull" the toilet paper sheets apart.
Constant use of toilet paper.

name: Run Away Bagels
description: with this ability, you will be able to eat a delicious bagel of your choice, wherever you are.  the Bagel would be just as you like with whatever you want on it.
summary: The ability to have a bagel whenever
strengths: Never go hungry
make everyone around you jealous
never have to dish out money for breakfast
weaknesses: Only you can eat the bagel
the bagel has to be eaten within a 2 hour time frame
may cause explosive poops

name: Trust Fall
description: With this power whenever you fall, someone who you trust will automatically teleport to you and catch you. After the person catches you you have the option to send them back to wherever they were before but you don't have to send them back.
summary: The ability to have someone catch you whenever you fall
strengths: Whenever you fall someone who you trust will catch you
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You may be endangering someone you trust

name: Summon Superkystian
description: The superkystian. Eight feet tall and looking like a mirrored manikin. Able to lift 450 tons and jump three miles high. Its non-kystian detection ability has a range of 3 miles. IQ 230. Runs 500 mph. Atomic or molecular manipulation won't work against a superkystian due to Kyst using inert pieces of Itself to make them. That is also the superkystians' weakness. An hour after summoning, it will lose 1% of its abilites for each minute over the hour. Superkystians can't be merged.
summary: The ability to summon the best kystian that can be summoned.
strengths: Immune to atomic and molecular manipulation.
Can be made to lift 3600 tons(enhanced kystian abilities power).
weaknesses: Superkystians need Kyst, like Superman needs a yellow sun.
Superkystians will become uncontrollable and mindless if you wait too long.

name: Oatmeal Bender
description: With this power, you can move oatmeal with sheer force of will. You can shape it, compact it, and transport it without any actual contact. The oatmeal can be dried and hardened into armor and weapons, and launched as projectiles. With enough concentration and practice, one could project a wad of oatmeal at near light speed, obliterating whatever it struck. You have access to a universe filled with oatmeal, and can teleport it in within 1 meter of your body, so you're not likely to run out.
summary: The ability to manipulate and control oatmeal with your mind.
strengths: Great for crowd control, and can always feed people.
Can densify and harden oatmeal to incredible strength.
Access to an effectively unlimited supply of oatmeal.
weaknesses: How do you define what is and what isn't oatmeal?
Not everyone likes oatmeal.
If something invades the oatmeal, it may not be oatmeal anymore, and you might lose control of it.

name: Spl User Summon
description: By saying "Superpower List" followed by the screen name of an SPL user (the screen name used on the main site, not the forums), you can summon the person(s) behind said user name to your close vicinity. Saying "Release" followed by the screen name of a summoned user allows you to unsummon them and return them back to the exact location they were summoned from. You can only summon an SPL user if they are really far from you.
summary: The ability to summon any SPL user to your location.
strengths: Murder the top user of the SPL (currently Vespert, but some day WHD), so they stop acquiring powers.
Meet and hang out with the SPL users you get along with.
Get in touch with users who left the SPL a long time ago.
weaknesses: Some screen names are unpronounceable and others are homophones, in which case the summon is random.
You may summon really creepy guys/girls, or even a group of people behind a single username.
It works with deceased users, but, well... You better have a solid heart and mind.

name: Mouche (Housefly)
description: By using your fly eyes, you can detect any enemy coming from behind you and then dodge accordingly
summary: The ability to dodge instantly once you see it with your fly eyes
strengths: Never be caught be surprised
Move really fast
Incredibly fast in flight.
weaknesses: Have to be a fly hybrid
Once you're caught, you're helpless
Poor offensive capabilities

name: Impregnation Through Sight
description: Impregnation through sight allows you to immediately and effortlessly impregnate any creature you look at, be they male, female, or other. Training this power lets you control the speed of the pregnancy and terminate ongoing pregnancies, both natural and supernatural. Works on men better than women since they would have to push the baby through their... Yeah... Ouch.
summary: The ability to impregnate creatures of both sexes by looking at them
strengths: Pretty much guarantees you will win seeing eye contests
Hilarious torture for your enemies
Want kids - Go have them
weaknesses: Accidental pregnancies
Must wear sunglasses to avoid using this power

name: Pencil Sharpener
description: Stick a pencil up your nose and its magically sharpened. The pencil shavings magically transport into your worst enemies house.
summary: The ability to sharpen pencils by sticking them up your nose
strengths: Sharpen pencils (Amaze girls with your pencil sharpening skills)
The pencil shavings transport to your worst enemies house
Maybe sticking other things up your nose will also sharpen them (never without a weapon)
weaknesses: May get boogers on your pencil
Sharpening pencil tickles
Never pick your nose again, because it may work like a normal pencil sharpener

name: Shampoo Breath
description: This ability you breathe shampoo at your enemies. Breathing in their eyes can blind them, in their ears can distort their hearing, and in their mouth can cause them to have that yuk bitter aftertaste shampoo has when you accidentally swallow it, while showering. Breathing on the ground can make things slippery. Also, you don't have to run to the shops for shampoo again.
summary: The ability to breathe shampoo at your enemies
strengths: Shampoo breath can be used to distort the opponent's senses.
Never run out of shampoo again.
You don't get that horrible bitter aftertaste.
weaknesses: Such an embarrassing ability to have.
You don't breathe conditioner.

name: Angry Birds: Star Wars
description: With this power you are given a remote with only button on it. When pressed the button causes a portal to open up allowing you to choose which Star Wars Angry Bird you want to be launched from the portal. You can only shoot one of each kind of bird at a time. If you loose the remote you can cause it to teleport back to you.
summary: The ability to summon any of the birds from Angry Birds: Star Wars
strengths: You can summon of the Star Wars Angry Birds
If you lose the remote you can teleport it back to you
weaknesses: You can only summon one of each kind of bird at a time
You cannot go through the portal

name: Homing Turd Flight
description:
Have a teacher you don't really like? Did someone betray you? or break your heart?

Poop on them!  With all the flying capabilities of superman and the car seeking abilities of flying rats, get payback!
summary: The ability to aim your excrement at desired targets while in flight!
strengths: Easily get revenge
weaknesses: People can watch you poop

name: Poop Master
description: With this ability, you gain the ULTIMATE means to exact revenge! You can spring your poop to life and command it to do your bidding. While it cannot talk, it CAN walk, run, and change shape. Whether it be for comedic purposes or strictly for business, it's your poop's duty to do its best to fulfill your needs. Put your poop on a mission. Send it into a crowd! Your imagination and your diet are your only limitations.
summary: The ability to bring poop to life to do your bidding.
strengths: Send your poop after someone to exact revenge
